examples.pitfall: 按规则变化写成 feeded、rided 是高频错误。

mistakes: was 配单数（I/he/she/it/the trip），were 配复数（you/we/they），They was、You was 都不对。
否定式 wasn't（=was not）和 weren't（=were not）里的撇号不能丢。
ride→rode、feed→fed、take→took、go→went 是不规则变化，不能画蛇添足加 -ed。
How was…? 问过去，How's…? 问现在——只差一个字母时态全变，回答也要用 It was…。

source.unit: Unit 11 How was your school trip?

exercises.question: 选词填空：—How _____ your trip last week? —It _____ excellent. I visited my grandparents in the countryside.
exercises.solution: your trip 和 It 都是单数，过去时都用 was；对话原句正是 It was excellent.

source.label: 人教新目标七下 P62·旅行对话（How was your trip last week? It was excellent.）

exercises.question: 补全问答：—_____ the strawberries good? —No, they _____.（草莓不好吃）
exercises.solution: the strawberries 是复数，用 Were 提问、weren't 回答，前后要一致。

source.label: 人教新目标七下 P63·Were the strawberries good?（Yes, they were./No, they weren't.）

exercises.question: 变式：给动词原形选正确的过去式——ride、feed、take 依次对应（　）
exercises.solution: ride-rode、feed-fed、take-took 都是不规则变化，直接背成对形式。

source.label: 人教新目标七下 P61·农场活动短语变式（rode a horse / fed chickens / took some photos）

exercises.question: 用三句英语记录你的一次外出：第一句总评（It was…），第二句说去了哪（We went to…），第三句用 was/were 或一个学过的不规则过去式补充细节。
exercises.answer: It was great! We went to the countryside. The air was so clean, and I took some photos.
exercises.solution: 参考：It was great! We went to the countryside. The air was so clean, and I took some photos.（总评+地点+细节，三句齐即可。）

lessons.summary: did 一问、过去式一答，把上周末做过的事说清楚：规则动词加 ed，不规则的背配对。
explanation: 书上先列六个周末活动词组：did my homework、went to the cinema、went boating、camped by the lake、went to the beach、played badminton，再用核心问答开场：—What did you do last weekend, Lucy? —Well, on Saturday morning, I played badminton.。语法聚焦表给出完整句型：—What did you do last weekend? —I did my homework. / We went boating.；—Who visited her grandma? —Becky did.；—Where did she go last weekend? —She went to a farm.；—Who did she go with? —She went with her classmates.。对话里 Lisa 说 I worked as a guide at the Natural History Museum.，Paul 惊叹 Really? How interesting!，还有一句 I stayed up late to watch the soccer game.。
一般过去时专门讲「已经做完的事」：上个周末、昨天、两周前发生的事，动词都要换成过去式。周一早上同学互相问周末干了什么，用的就是 What did you do last weekend?——问的人和答的人都知道事情已经过去了，所以动词不能再用原形和三单形式。

变形有章法：规则动词直接加 ed（play→played、visit→visited、clean→cleaned），以不发音的 e 结尾只加 d，辅音字母加 y 结尾变 y 为 i 再加 ed（study→studied）；不规则的当配对卡背：do→did、go→went、see→saw、feed→fed、take→took、have→had、come→came、fly→flew、swim→swam、ride→rode。问句结构是「疑问词＋did＋主语＋动词原形」：What did you do last weekend?，答句再把动词换成过去式。

三个易混点：一是问句里已经有 did 扛着「过去」这面旗，后面的动词要退回原形，说 What did you do? 不说 What did you did?；二是答句里的 did 能代替前面出现过的动词——Who visited her grandma? 回答 Becky did.，这个 did 就等于 visited，避免重复；三是抓时间标志，last weekend、yesterday、two weeks ago 一出现，基本就要用过去时。
实义动词过去时和 be 动词过去时（How was your trip? It was great.）合在一起，你就能完整讲一段过去的事了：先问答，再连成几句小叙事，最后写成周末短文。不规则动词配对是长期积累——每见一对背一对，书后的不规则动词表就是你自己的「打卡清单」。

methods.name: 过去式变形三条路
steps: 规则动词词尾直接加 ed：play→played、visit→visited、clean→cleaned
以不发音的 e 结尾只加 d；辅音字母加 y 结尾变 y 为 i 再加 ed：study→studied
不规则动词当配对卡背：do→did、go→went、see→saw、feed→fed、take→took、have→had
每学一篇短文就把新出现的不规则动词收进配对卡
methods.tip: 直接加 ed、去 e 只加 d、变 y 为 i；不规则的见一对背一对。

methods.name: did 问答三步法
steps: 第一步抓时间标志：last weekend、yesterday、two weeks ago，锁定过去时
第二步组问句：疑问词＋did＋主语＋动词原形，如 What did you do last weekend?
第三步组答句：动词换过去式，如 I did my homework. / We went boating.
追问人物用 Who did you go with?，回答 She went with her classmates.
methods.tip: 问句 did 扛旗、动词回原形；答句动词穿上过去式外衣。

examples.question: 补全问答：—What did you do last weekend? —I ___ my homework.（横线处用 do 的正确形式）
examples.solution: 填 did。问句里已有 did，答句要说做过的事，do 要换成过去式 did：I did my homework.
examples.pitfall: 顺着问句填 do——答句讲的是过去做的事，动词必须换成过去式。

examples.question: 写出下面三组动词的过去式：go、feed、see。
examples.solution: go→went、feed→fed、see→saw。这三个都是不规则动词，不能硬加 ed，要按配对背。
examples.pitfall: 写成 goed、feeded、seed——不规则动词加 ed 是最常见的错。

examples.question: 同学问你：—Who did you go to the cinema with? 你是和爸爸一起去的，用英语回答。
examples.solution: I went there with my father. 参照句型 —Who did she go with? —She went with her classmates.，答句动词用过去式 went。
examples.pitfall: 答成 I go there with my father.——问的是过去的事，go 要变 went。

mistakes: 问句里动词忘了还原，写成 What did you did?——did 后面的动词必须用原形 do。
不规则动词硬加 ed：goed、feeded 都不对，要背 went、fed、saw、took 这类配对。
把 What do you do?（问日常或职业）和 What did you do?（问过去的事）混用——一字之差，时态全变。
studied 拼成 studyed——辅音字母加 y 结尾要变 y 为 i 再加 ed。

source.unit: Unit 12 What did you do last weekend?

exercises.question: —What did you do last weekend? —I ___ badminton with my father.
exercises.solution: last weekend 提示过去的事，动词用过去式：play→played。

source.label: 人教新目标七下 P67·活动词组与核心问答（What did you do last weekend, Lucy? I played badminton.）

exercises.question: 补全疑问词：—___ did she go last weekend? —She went to a farm.
exercises.solution: 答句回答去了哪儿（a farm 是地点），问句用 Where 问地点。

source.label: 人教新目标七下 P69·语法聚焦问答表（Where did she go last weekend? She went to a farm.）

exercises.question: 下面哪一组动词过去式全部正确？
exercises.solution: take→took、feed→fed 都是不规则变化；goed、feeded、taked、seed 都是硬加 ed 的错形。

source.label: 人教新目标七下 P68·听力句变式（I fed some sheep. I went to a farm. 不规则过去式配对改选择）

exercises.question: 把打乱的四个句子排成一段通顺对话：①What did you do last weekend? ②My classmates. ③I did my homework and went boating. ④Who did you go with?
exercises.solution: 先用 What 问做了什么，答句说两件事；再用 Who did you go with? 追问同伴，答 My classmates. 收尾。学会这条问答链，可以接着采访三个同学，把他们的周末记成小档案。

lessons.summary: 写 My last weekend：时间总起、三件活动全用过去式、感受收尾，写完专查动词过去式。
explanation: 书上先给填空范文：I had a busy weekend. On Saturday morning, I cleaned my room. In the afternoon, I ___ . It was a little difficult. On Saturday night, I stayed at home and cooked dinner. On Sunday morning, I read a book about history. … I saw an interesting talk show.；再用任务 Write about what you did last weekend. 让你自己写。长范文 A Weekend to Remember 用时间开场：My sister finished high school two weeks ago. As a special gift, our parents took us to India. Last weekend was interesting but scary.，结尾点出收获：This was a very useful lesson for me.
过去时记叙文有三件套：什么时候＋做了什么＋感觉怎样。像放录像带一样按时间顺序走：Saturday morning→afternoon→night，再到 Sunday morning→afternoon→night，读者跟着你的时间线一步一步看，文章自然就顺了。

四步成文（控制在 60-70 词）：第一步总起一句，交代时间与整体感受，如 I had a busy weekend.；第二步按时间线写三件活动，On Saturday morning, I cleaned my room. In the afternoon, I did my homework. On Sunday night, I saw an interesting talk show.，每句动词都用过去式；第三步加一句感受收尾，It was fun. / I was tired but happy.；第四步写完逐句检查动词过去式。
四个易错点：一是写着写着跳回现在时，前后时态要统一成过去；二是不规则动词硬加 ed（goed、sayed），要回配对卡核对 went、said；三是 On Saturday morning 的 On 和星期都要大写；四是 homework 不可数，别加 s。写完把动词圈出来挨个查，是这类作文的固定收尾动作。
这个框架以后一直用得上：下学期写日记（日期开头）、写更长的记叙文，都是「总起—按顺序叙事—感受收尾」这三段式。再把 first、then、after that 这类连接词加进去，活动之间就更有先后感。

methods.name: 周末记叙四步框架
steps: 第一步总起：I had a busy weekend. 一句交代时间与总印象
第二步按时间线写三件事：On Saturday morning…→In the afternoon…→On Sunday night…，动词全部过去式
第三步感受收尾：It was fun. / I was tired but happy.
第四步控制篇幅在 60-70 词
methods.tip: 总起给时间，三事排成线，感受来收尾。

methods.name: 写后动词检查法
steps: 逐句圈出每一个动词
规则动词查词尾 ed：played、visited、studied
不规则动词回配对卡核对：did、went、saw、fed、took
最后数一遍词数，落在 60-70 之间
methods.tip: 动词圈一圈，ed 别漏填，不规则对卡看。

examples.question: 下面两句哪句正确：A. I goed to the beach. B. I went to the beach. 为什么？
examples.solution: B 对。go 是不规则动词，过去式是 went，不能加 ed。写作文时遇到这类词要回配对卡核对。
examples.pitfall: 觉得动词加 ed 就是过去式——不规则动词是例外，硬加 ed 一眼就露馅。

examples.question: I had a busy weekend. 后面接哪一句更符合时间线：A. On Saturday morning, I cleaned my room. B. Tomorrow I will play soccer.
examples.solution: A。周末已经过去，要从 Saturday morning 讲起；B 讲的是明天，时态和内容都接不上。
examples.pitfall: 只看句子本身对不对，忘了检查它和总起句的时间是否连贯。

examples.question: 给写完的活动补一个感受句：你周末去了海边，玩得很开心，用英语写一句收尾。
examples.solution: It was so much fun. / I was very happy. 用过去式 be 动词（was）把感受收住。
examples.pitfall: 写成 It is so much fun.——感受也是当时的，动词要用过去式。

mistakes: 全文时态跳来跳去：前一句 did my homework，后一句突然变成 I am playing basketball——叙事文要统一用过去时。
不规则动词硬加 ed：goed、sayed、feeled 都是错的，要背 went、said、felt。
时间短语书写不规范：on saturday morning 应为 On Saturday morning——介词 On 和星期首字母都要大写。
可数与不可数弄混：homework 不可数，说 did my homeworks 就错了。

exercises.question: 下面哪一句动词过去式用得完全正确？
options: I studyed for the English test.
I goed to the library and read books.
I did my homework and went boating.
I taked some photos at the zoo.
exercises.solution: did 是 do 的过去式，went 是 go 的过去式，都对；studyed（应 studied）、goed、taked 都是错形。

source.label: 人教新目标七下 P72·看图完形与词组（I had a busy weekend. did my homework / went boating）

exercises.question: 范文里有一句讲周日晚上的活动：看了（一档有趣的脱口秀）。把这句用英语写出来，补在 On Sunday night, 之后。
exercises.answer: I saw an interesting talk show.
exercises.solution: 「看节目」用 see：see an interesting talk show，过去式 saw；「一档」用不定冠词 an。

source.label: 人教新目标七下 P72·看图完形短文（I saw an interesting talk show.）

exercises.question: 把打乱的四个句子排成一段通顺的小短文：①I had a happy weekend. ②It was so much fun. ③On Saturday morning, I visited my grandma. ④In the afternoon, I flew a kite with my friends.
exercises.solution: 总起句 ① 开头，按时间线 ③（Saturday morning）→④（in the afternoon），感受句 ② 收尾。

source.label: 人教新目标七下 P72·叙事短文变式（总起+时间线+感受排序成文）

exercises.question: 同桌的短文里有一句 She go to the library yesterday.。指出错误并改正，再说出你写完周末短文后要检查的两件事。
exercises.answer: She went to the library yesterday.；检查动词过去式（规则加 ed、不规则对卡核对）和词数（60-70）。
exercises.solution: yesterday 提示过去时，go 要改成 went；写后先逐句圈动词查过去式，再数词数。这个检查习惯以后写日记、写游记都用得上。

lessons.summary: 问路一条线：问在哪—沿着走—转弯—致谢；电话找人不在，就按四句式把口信留下。
explanation: 问路对话书上这样说：—Hi, excuse me. —Yes. How can I help you? —Well, I'm new in town. Is there a bank around here? —Yes, there is. It's on Center Street. It's across from the park. —Oh, that's great! Thanks so much. —No problem.。路线句用三个动词短语搭起来：Just go along Bridge Street and turn left when you see the library. / Turn right at the first crossing and the restaurant is on your left, next to the pay phone. / Thank you very much. —You're welcome.。电话对话：—Hello, Rick speaking. —Hi, Rick. It's Steve. —Is your brother at home? —Oh, he's not here. Can I take a message for him? —Yes. Could you just tell him to call me back? —Sure, no problem.；另一组：—Hello? Jenny speaking. —Hi, Jenny. It's Steve here. May I speak to Laura, please? —Sorry, she's not at home. Can I take a message? —Yes. Could you ask her to call me at 8765-4321? —Sure, no problem.
问路像一场接力：招呼（Excuse me）→提问（Is there…near here?）→指路→致谢，一棒接一棒，少一棒对话就断。电话里有个特别约定：说「我是谁」不用 I'm…，要说 This is… 或 … speaking；要找的人不在，就把话留下——这就是留言（take a message）。

指路三件套按顺序记：go along（沿着走）→turn left/right（转弯）→on your left/right（在路哪一侧），再配方位词 across from（隔街相对）、next to（紧挨着）、between…and…（在两者之间）。电话三件套：自报家门（Hello, Jenny speaking. / This is Jenny.）→找人（May I speak to…, please?）→留言（Can I take a message? / Could you tell him to call me back?），留言要记全三样：找谁、谁留、回电号码（call me at 8765-4321）。
易混点有三：一是 turn left 是「向左转」的动作，on your left 是「在你左手边」的位置，先转弯再看目标在哪侧；二是电话自报用 This is Steve，不说 I'm Steve——这是电话专用礼貌用法；三是 across from 指隔街正对，不是 next to 的紧挨着，指路时一字之差就把人带偏了。
这两套本领在生活中马上能用：出门旅行问路、帮家人接电话转口信，都是真实场景。它们也是听力考试的常客——听对话抓路线词（along、turn、next to）和电话关键词（message、call back、号码），练熟了开口和听力一起进步。

methods.name: 连贯指路四步法
steps: 第一步招呼：Excuse me.
第二步提问：Is there a bank near here? / How can I get to…?
第三步听或说路线：抓 go along、turn left/right、on your left/right 和方位词 across from、next to
第四步致谢：Thanks so much. —You're welcome.
methods.tip: 一问二沿三转四谢，左右方向别颠倒。

methods.name: 电话留言四句式
steps: 接电话自报：Hello, Jenny speaking. / This is Jenny.
找人：May I speak to Laura, please?
人不在就留言：Can I take a message? / Could you tell him to call me back?
记全三样再确认：找谁、谁留、回电号码（call me at 8765-4321），最后 Sure, no problem.
methods.tip: This is 报家门，留言抓三样：找谁、谁留、回电号码。

examples.question: 电话接通了，接电话的是 Jenny，但你要找 Laura。你的第一句英语该怎么说？
examples.solution: May I speak to Laura, please? 电话里找人用 May I speak to…, please?，客气又清楚。
examples.pitfall: 张口就喊 Laura 的名字，或说成 I am Laura——那是自报家门，不是找人。

examples.question: 同伴先说 Turn left at the library.，又说 The restaurant is on your left.。两个 left 的意思一样吗？
examples.solution: 不完全一样。turn left 是「向左转」的动作，on your left 是「在你左手边」的位置：先在图书馆左转，再看餐厅在你行进方向的左侧。
examples.pitfall: 把两个 left 都理解成左转，转完还原地再转一次——位置和动作要分开想。

examples.question: 你替妈妈留言：Could you ask her to call me ___ 8765-4321? 空里填哪个介词？
examples.solution: 填 at。call sb. at＋电话号码是固定搭配，表示「打这个号码找某人」。
examples.pitfall: 顺手填 to 或 with——号码前面固定用 at。

mistakes: 电话自报说成 I'm Steve——电话里要说 This is Steve（或 Steve speaking），这是专用礼貌用法。
把 across from 和 next to 混用：across from 是隔街正对，next to 是紧挨着，指路弄反会把人带错。
留言漏记回电号码：完整留言要有找谁、谁留、号码三样，Could you ask her to call me at＋号码。
问路忘了开头招呼，直接冲出 Where's the bank?——先说 Excuse me. 再提问，才有礼貌也更容易得到帮助。

exercises.question: 你打电话找 Laura，接电话的是 Jenny。你最该说：
options: May I speak to Laura, please?
exercises.solution: 找人的固定句式是 May I speak to…, please?；A 是接电话者的自报，C 是自报找自己，D 是对方忙音时才说的。

source.label: 人教新目标七下 P42·电话用语匹配（May I speak to Laura, please?）

exercises.question: 补全指路对话：—Excuse me. Is there a bank around here? —Yes, there is. It's on Center Street. It's ___ the park.（隔街正对公园）
exercises.solution: 「隔街正对」用 across from；between 要和 and 连用，behind 是在后面，on 直接接街道名。

source.label: 人教新目标七下 P44·问路对话（Is there a bank around here? It's across from the park.）

exercises.question: 把打乱的四个句子排成完整的指路对话：①Excuse me. Is there a post office near here? ②Go along Bridge Street and turn left at the library. ③Thank you very much. ④Yes, there is. It's next to the bank, on your right.
exercises.solution: 先招呼并提问 ①，对方先答有没有 ④，再给具体路线 ②，最后致谢 ③。按「问—答—路线—谢」的接力顺序就排对了。

source.label: 人教新目标七下 P46·指路路线变式（go along、turn left、next to 连贯排序）

exercises.question: 妈妈让你给同学小林传话：周六上午九点在公园集合。用四句英语写一段电话留言对话（自报、人不在留言、记下内容、确认）。
exercises.answer: 示例：—Hello? This is Mary. Is Lin at home? —Sorry, he's out. Can I take a message? —Yes. Could you ask him to meet at the park at nine on Saturday morning? —Sure, no problem.
exercises.solution: 按电话留言四句式来写：This is 自报、take a message 留言、说清时间地点、no problem 确认。写完自己演一遍，检查时间地点信息有没有说全。

lessons.summary: 读人物与地点短文：读前猜话题，读中抓 who、what、where 细节，读后合书复述。
explanation: 人物自述短文这样写：Hi, I'm Ma Huan. I can play ping-pong and chess. I like to talk and play games with people. ／ Hello, I'm Peter. I can speak English and I can also play soccer. ／ My name's Alan. I'm in the school music club. I can play the guitar and the piano. I can sing and dance, too.。地点介绍短文这样写：There is a zoo in my neighborhood. I like to spend time there on weekends. To get there, I usually walk out and turn right on Bridge Road.；I live in a noisy neighborhood. There is a post office between my house and a clothes store.。读前指令本身就是方法：先 Guess what the story is about.，再带着问题读。
人物介绍是一张会说话的名片：名字＋会什么（can）＋喜欢什么（like）；地点介绍是一张会说话的小地图：住在哪＋有什么（there is/are）＋怎么走（turn、walk along）。知道这两张「卡」长什么样，读之前就能猜出文章会写什么。
三步阅读法：第一步读前——看标题、读首句、看插图，猜话题和会出现的词；第二步读中——带着 who、what、where、how 的问题读，圈出人名、地名和动词短语，细节题回到原文找原句；第三步读后——合上书复述，先用三个问题搭架子（人物：谁、会什么、喜欢什么；地点：在哪、有什么、怎么走），再补一个原文细节。
易错点有三：一是句型抓错——人物文要盯 can 和 like 句，地点文要盯 there is/are 和方位词，抓错句型细节就找不准；二是细节题凭印象答，最容易掉坑，答案一定要回原句核对；三是把「作者喜欢」读成「大家都喜欢」——短文里 John 说 The best things in life are free!，那只是他的看法。
读完最好的输出是仿写：照着人物自述写三句介绍自己，照着社区短文写一段自己家周围的小地图。这套「猜—找—说」的流程，之后读更长的记叙文、说明文照样用，读得越熟，开口复述就越顺。

methods.name: 读前三猜法
steps: 看标题猜话题：是介绍人，还是介绍地方？
读首句猜主旨：第一句往往点出全文要说的事
猜文中会出现的词，读的时候对照验证
methods.tip: 先猜后读，读得又快又准。

methods.name: 细节定位三查
steps: 把问题里的关键词圈出来：人名、地名、动词短语
回原文找含关键词的原句
答案与原句逐词核对后再落笔
methods.tip: 答案藏在原句里，找到再下笔。

methods.name: 复述三问支架
steps: 人物文自问三句：他是谁？会什么？喜欢什么？
地点文自问三句：在哪？有什么？怎么走？
先答三问搭架子，再补一个原文细节
methods.tip: 三问答全，短文就装进你脑子里了。

examples.question: Alan 在哪个社团？用原文回答。
examples.solution: I'm in the school music club. 转述给别人听时换成 He's in the school music club.
examples.pitfall: 记成 chess club——会下棋的是 Ma Huan，人物和特长要对上号。

examples.question: Anna 周末喜欢去哪儿？为什么喜欢？
examples.solution: 她喜欢去小区里的动物园：There is a zoo in my neighborhood. I like to spend time there on weekends. 她爱看猴子爬来爬去，觉得它们像自己和朋友们。
examples.pitfall: 把 John 的公园当成 Anna 喜欢的地方——三段短文人物要分清，答案回各自的原段找。

examples.question: 用三句话复述 Peter 的情况。
examples.solution: He's Peter. He can speak English and he can also play soccer. He likes playing basketball. 复述时把 I'm 换成 He's、I like 换成 He likes。
examples.pitfall: 复述忘了变三单：I like 要改成 He likes——人称一换，动词形式跟着换。

mistakes: 人物文细节去地点文里找：问「谁在音乐社团」却盯着 there is 句型看——先判断文章类型，再抓对句型。
细节题凭印象作答：觉得「好像是 Alan」就选，正确做法是回原文找到 I'm in the school music club. 这句再确认。
复述时人称和动词不换：把 I can play the guitar. 原样背出来当 Alan 的情况——要说 He can play the guitar.
把作者的个人感受当成事实：短文里写 The best things in life are free!，那是 John 的看法，不是每段短文的共同结论。

exercises.question: 三位同学都做了自我介绍。谁在学校音乐社团？
exercises.solution: Alan 的原句是 My name's Alan. I'm in the school music club.；Ma Huan 会下棋，Peter 会踢足球说英语。

source.label: 人教新目标七下 P5·人物自述短文（My name's Alan. I'm in the school music club.）

exercises.question: 短文里 Anna 写了去动物园的路线。用英语把这个路线写出来（两句以内）。
exercises.answer: She walks out and turns right on Bridge Road, then walks along Bridge Road. The zoo is on the right.
exercises.solution: 原文是 To get there, I usually walk out and turn right on Bridge Road. Then I walk along Bridge Road. The zoo is on the right. 转述时 I 变 she，动词加 s。

source.label: 人教新目标七下 P47·社区介绍短文（To get there, I usually walk out and turn right on Bridge Road.）

exercises.question: 滑铁索上学的亮亮每天过河上学，他为什么不怕？
options: 因为他爱他的同学和老师
因为老师每天背他过河
exercises.solution: 原文说 he is not afraid because he loves school，还引用他的话：I love to play with my classmates. And I love my teacher. He's like a father to me.

source.label: 人教新目标七下 P17·山村上学短文变式（I love to play with my classmates. He's like a father to me.）

exercises.question: 仿照人物自述，用三句英语介绍自己：一句说名字、一句说 can 会什么、一句说 like 喜欢什么。写完读给同桌听，互相找一找你们的共同点。
exercises.answer: 示例：Hi, I'm Li Ming. I can swim. I like to play games with my friends.
exercises.solution: 照「名字＋can＋like」的名片框架写，每句一个信息。说给同桌听后再互相提问 Who can…? Who likes…?，把阅读学到的框架变成自己的表达。

lessons.summary: 全册约 570 词大盘点：逐课默写清红色词，动词四态卡把现在、进行、过去连成线。
explanation: 书后的词汇表按字母顺序排，每个词条标了词性、音标、中文意思和出处位置，全册累计约 570 词；另有不规则动词表两栏对照：am/is—was、are—were、do—did、go—went、see—saw、feed—fed、take—took、have—had、come—came、fly—flew、swim—swam、ride—rode、buy—bought、teach—taught、tell—told、write—wrote 等，名词还标注复数变化（tooth，复数 teeth）。
词汇表就像全册的地图：哪个词在哪个话题学过，翻表就能定位。自查相当于定期盘点库存——四会词要做到会读、会写、会说、会用，光「看着眼熟」不算数，合上表能默出来才算过。

三查法把整册词盘清：第一查逐课默写——四会词全对才过关，错的抄进错词本并回原文句子读三遍；第二查时态三态转换——给动词写四态：原形—三单—ing—过去式，如 watch—watches—watching—watched、study—studies—studying—studied、go—goes—going—went；第三查三单专项——主语是 he/she/it 时动词要加 s：does、has、watches、studies，用词表当清单逐项打勾。
易混点集中在动词变形上：三单的 s 和过去式的 ed 别打架——She watches TV every day. 说习惯，She watched TV yesterday. 说过去，时间标志和动词形式要一起换；study 的三单要变 y 为 i 加 es（studies），过去式是 studied；不规则动词绝不能硬加 ed，goed、feeded 都是错的，要说 went、fed。
这套盘点法别只用在期末：每月自查一次，红色词（还没过关的）越来越少，就是进步。错词本和动词四态卡会一直陪你到下学期——以后学新时态、新词汇，照旧「默写、转换、打勾」三步走，词汇量就滚起来了。

methods.name: 逐课默写三色法
steps: 按课默写四会词：会的打勾、模糊的画圈、错的标红
红色词抄进错词本，回原文句子读三遍
三天后只重测红色词，过关就划掉
methods.tip: 红色词是宝贝，每周和它见一面。

methods.name: 动词四态卡
steps: 每个动词写四格：原形—三单—ing—过去式
先填规则词：watch—watches—watching—watched
再填不规则词：go—goes—going—went、study—studies—studying—studied
错格标红，按配对背，隔三天重测
methods.tip: 一卡四态连成线，时态转换不打架。

examples.question: 写出 study 的三单形式和过去式。
examples.solution: 三单 studies、过去式 studied。study 以辅音字母加 y 结尾：三单变 y 为 i 加 es，过去式变 y 为 i 加 ed。
examples.pitfall: 写成 studys、studyed——y 前是辅音字母时必须变 y 为 i。

examples.question: 把 My sister watches TV every day. 改成说昨天的事。
examples.solution: My sister watched TV yesterday. watches 变 watched，every day 换成 yesterday——动词形式和时间标志一起换。
examples.pitfall: 只把动词变过去式，时间词还留着 every day——时态和时间要配套改。

examples.question: 下面哪种安排最能查出还没掌握的词？为什么？
examples.solution: 逐课默写，并把错的词回原文句子、三天后重测。只抄词表或只看中文，手没动笔、脑子没提取，查不出真正没过关的词。
examples.pitfall: 把「看着眼熟」当成「已经会了」——合上表默不出来就是没过。

mistakes: 三单和过去式打架：She watched TV every day. 想说习惯要用 watches，every day 配一般现在时。
不规则动词硬加 ed：goed、feeded、taked 都是错的，要说 went、fed、took。
study 类动词忘了变 y：三单写 studys、过去式写 studyed 都不对，应是 studies、studied。
自查只动眼不动手：翻词表觉得都会，一默写就漏——四会词必须默写过关才算数。

exercises.question: feed 的过去式是：
exercises.solution: feed 是不规则动词，过去式 fed，和 see—saw、take—took 一样按配对背。

source.label: 人教新目标七下 P141·不规则动词表（feed—fed、see—saw、take—took）

exercises.question: 用一般过去时把这句话变成上周的事：I go to the library every weekend.
exercises.answer: I went to the library last weekend.
exercises.solution: go 的过去式是 went；every weekend（每次周末，习惯）换成 last weekend（上周末，过去的时间点）。

source.label: 人教新目标七下 P69·动词形式转换（What did you do last weekend? I did my homework.）

exercises.question: My sister ___ for the English test last night.（study 的正确形式）
exercises.solution: last night 是过去的标志词，用过去式 studied：变 y 为 i 加 ed。

source.label: 人教新目标七下 P68·听力句变式（I studied for the English test.）

exercises.question: 复习整册词汇时，下面哪种做法最有效？
options: 把词表从头到尾抄一遍
只背不规则动词表，其余的词略过
按课默写，把错的词回原文句子并三天后重测
只看中文意思回想英文，不动笔写
exercises.solution: 按课默写能定位到具体哪课的词没过关，错词回原文能连句子一起记住，隔三天重测才真正巩固；抄一遍、只看不说、只背一小块都会留死角。

lessons.summary: 用 Did you go anywhere interesting? 聊假期：something special 这类不定代词要把形容词放在身后，过去时问答一起练。
explanation: 开学先聊假期。配对活动给出七个假期活动：stayed at home、went to New York City、visited my uncle、went to summer camp、went to the mountains、went to the beach、visited museums，核心问答链是：Where did you go on vacation? —I went to the mountains.／Grace, where did you go on vacation? —I went to New York City. —Oh, really? Did you go with anyone? —Yes, I went with my mother. 老朋友重逢的对话里，Rick 问 Helen：Oh, did you go anywhere interesting? Helen 答 Yes, I went to Guizhou with my family.，又反问 Did you do anything special last month? Rick 说 Not really. I just stayed at home most of the time to read and relax. 语法聚焦把不定代词问答归成一串：Did you go out with anyone? —No. No one was here. Everyone was on vacation.／Did you buy anything special? —Yes, I bought something for my father.／No, I bought nothing.／How was the food? Everything tasted really good!／Did everyone have a good time? —Oh, yes. Everything was excellent. 选词练习把 anyone、something、anything、everything、nothing、everyone、no one 放进同一组对话反复操练；旅行日记里还有一句活例：For lunch, we had something very special — Malaysian yellow noodles. They were delicious!

something、anything、nothing、everyone 这些词叫不定代词——专门指「说不清具体是哪个」的人、物、地方。它们分三家人：some- 家（something、someone、somewhere）常住在肯定句里；any- 家（anything、anyone、anywhere）常住在疑问句和否定句里；no- 家（nothing、no one）自己就带着「没有」的意思。它们还有一条特别的规矩：形容词要贴在身后——不能说 special something，要说 something special，就像中文说「特别的东西」，英语的顺序是「东西在前、形容在后」。Did you go anywhere interesting? 问的就是「去了什么有意思的地方吗」，interesting 站在 anywhere 后面。

选词三步走：第一步看句型——肯定句先找 some- 家，疑问句、否定句先找 any- 家，句子里已经有 no 的否定再用 no- 家；第二步看指代——-thing 结尾指物，-one 或 -body 结尾指人，-where 结尾指地点；第三步排语序——有形容词就放到不定代词后面：anything special、something important。回答也配好对：Did you buy anything special? 有两种回答——Yes, I bought something for my father. 或 No, I bought nothing.。谓语动词还有一条铁律：no one、everyone、everything 都当单数用——No one was here. Everyone was on vacation.，was 别写成 were。

容易绊倒的地方有四：一是形容词位置——something special 不能写成 special something，复合不定代词的形容词一律后置；二是疑问句里的 some 与 any——一般疑问句用 anything（Did you do anything special?），只有真心盼着对方说 Yes 的客套问句才用 something；三是 no one 和 nothing 分工不同——no one 指人（No one was here.），nothing 指物（I bought nothing.），别拿 nothing 去说人；四是 no one 的写法——两个词分开写，不能挤成 noone，而 everyone、everything 反而是一整个词。

假期话题把七年级学的一般过去时又拉出来练了一圈：went to the mountains、visited my uncle、stayed at home、took photos，问句一律用 Did you…? 开头。把不定代词用顺了，往后写假期日记、写旅行见闻就有词可用——像 We had something very special 这样的句子往文里一放，文章立刻活起来。再提一个学习习惯：每次长假结束，试着用三五个 Did you…? 问句和同学互相采访一次，练的正是「过去时+不定代词」这对老搭档，越用越熟。

methods.name: 不定代词三步选词法
steps: 第一步看句型：肯定句用 some- 家（something、someone），疑问句、否定句用 any- 家（anything、anyone、anywhere），句中已有 no 再用 no- 家（nothing、no one）
第二步看指代：-thing 指物、-one 或 -body 指人、-where 指地点
第三步排语序：形容词放在不定代词后面——anything special、something important
methods.tip: 肯 some 疑 any 否 no；物 thing 人 one 地方 where；形容词站队尾

methods.name: 问答配对训练法
steps: 问句用 any- 开路：Did you go with anyone?／Did you buy anything special?
肯定答用 some-：Yes, I went with my mother.／Yes, I bought something for my father.
否定答用 no- 或 not：No, I bought nothing.／Not really. I just stayed at home.
methods.tip: any 问出题，some 接好消息，no 直说没有

examples.question: 选词填空：—Did you go out with anyone?　—No. ______ was here.（从 No one、Nothing、Anyone 里选）
examples.solution: No one was here. 空格说的是「没有人」，指人用 no one，谓语用单数 was；nothing 指物，anyone 一般不用于肯定句。
examples.pitfall: 误选 Nothing——nothing 指物不指人，这句说的是「这里没有人」。

examples.question: 下面两句只有一句语序正确，把它找出来：A. I bought special something for my mother.　B. I bought something special for my mother.
examples.solution: B。something special 是「特别的东西」——形容词要放在不定代词后面；A 把形容词放在了前面，不成话。
examples.pitfall: 照中文「特别的东西」的顺序去排英文，把形容词放在了前面。

examples.question: 补全句子：For lunch, we had ______ — Malaysian yellow noodles.（用 something 和 very special 补全）
examples.solution: something very special。日记原句：we had something very special — Malaysian yellow noodles. 形容词 very special 整体跟在 something 后面。
examples.pitfall: 丢了 very，或把语序排成 very special something。

mistakes: 形容词放错位：要说 something special、anything interesting，形容词永远跟在不定代词后面，special something 不成话。
疑问句乱用 some：Did you do anything special? 是疑问句，用 anything；something 一般只在肯定句或期待对方答 Yes 的客套问句里出现。
no one 和 nothing 张冠李戴：no one 指人（No one was here.），nothing 指物（I bought nothing.）；no one 还要分开写，不能写成 noone。
everyone 当复数：everyone、everything、no one 后面的谓语动词用单数——Everyone was on vacation. 不说 Everyone were。

source.unit: Unit 1 Where did you go on vacation?

exercises.question: —Did you go out with anyone?　—No. ______ was here. Everyone was on vacation.　A. No one　B. Anyone　C. Nothing
exercises.solution: 语法聚焦原句：Did you go out with anyone? No. No one was here. Everyone was on vacation. 指人用 no one，谓语用单数 was。

source.label: 人教新目标八上 P3·语法聚焦不定代词问答（Did you go out with anyone? No. No one was here. Everyone was on vacation.）

exercises.question: 补全对话：—Did you buy ______ special?　—Yes, I bought ______ for my father.（依次填入合适的不定代词）
exercises.solution: 问句是疑问句，用 anything（Did you buy anything special?）；肯定回答用 something（Yes, I bought something for my father.）。

source.label: 人教新目标八上 P3·语法聚焦问答（Did you buy anything special? Yes, I bought something for my father.）

exercises.question: 把下面的词排成一句通顺的话：we / had / something / very special / for lunch（提示：注意 something 的形容词后置）
exercises.answer: We had something very special for lunch.
exercises.solution: 旅行日记原句：For lunch, we had something very special — Malaysian yellow noodles. something 和形容词不能断开，very special 整体跟在后面。

source.label: 人教新目标八上 P5·旅行日记（we had something very special — Malaysian yellow noodles.）变式（不定代词+形容词后置排序）

exercises.question: 假期结束回到学校，用 Did you go anywhere interesting?、Did you do anything special? 这样的问句采访两位同学，把一问一答记下来，再检查每个不定代词后面的形容词有没有站对位置。
exercises.answer: 开放作答，如：—Did you do anything special? —Yes, I learned something new at the science museum.
exercises.solution: 问句用 any- 家，肯定回答用 some- 家；形容词后置（anything interesting、something new）是检查重点。

lessons.summary: How often 问频率：六档频度词从 always 排到 never，twice a week 报次数，hardly ever 是几乎不做。
explanation: 这一部分先摆出频度阶梯：always (100%)、usually、often、sometimes、hardly ever、never (0%)，配的问答是：What do you do on weekends? —I usually watch TV.／Do you go shopping? —No, I never go shopping. 接着出现精确次数档：How often do you watch TV? —Twice a week.；表格里给出活动 go to the movies、watch TV、shop、exercise、read 和频度 every day、once a week、twice a week、three times a week、once a month、twice a month。角色对话里 Claire 说自己报了 dance and piano lessons：swing dance 的课 I have class once a week, every Monday.；Jack 问 How often do you have piano lessons? Claire 答 Twice a week, on Wednesday and Friday. 语法聚焦归纳六组问答：What do you usually do on weekends? —I always exercise.／What does she do on weekends? —She sometimes goes shopping.／How often do you go to the movies? —I go to the movies maybe once a month.／How often does he watch TV? —He hardly ever watches TV.／Do you go shopping? —No, I never go shopping. 健康调查把问句对到生活上：How often do you exercise?／How often do you eat junk food?／How often do you drink milk?——I drink milk every day.

how often 问的是「多久做一次」，就像问打卡频率。回答有两种报法：一种是报档位——天天做就说 always 或 every day，几乎不做用 hardly ever，从来不干用 never；另一种是报精确次数——次数加一段时间：once a week 一周一次、twice a week 一周两次、three times a week 一周三次，时间段可以换成 a month、a year。频度词在句子里站的位置也有讲究：放在实义动词前面（He hardly ever watches TV.）、be 动词后面，有了位置感，句子才地道。

频率问答三步走：第一步听清问的是什么——What do you usually do 问的是做什么活动，答句报活动（I always exercise.）；How often 问的是做几次，答句报频率（Twice a week.）；第二步看主语——主语是三单（he、she）时问句用 does、答句动词加 s：How often does he watch TV? —He hardly ever watches TV.；第三步选档报数——一次 once、两次 twice、三次及以上用数字加 times，后面接 a week / a month / a year。次数说不准就加 maybe：I go to the movies maybe once a month.

四个坑要绕开：一是 twice 别写成 two time——两次用 twice，三次以上才说 three times；二是 hardly ever 不是「经常」，它的意思是 almost never「几乎不」，和 often 方向相反；三是 every day 要分开写——表示「每天」的状语是两个词，挤成 everyday 就成了形容词「日常的」；四是 sometimes 位置最自由，句首句中都能放（Sometimes I read.／I sometimes read.），但 hardly ever 通常紧跟在实义动词前面。

有了这套频度表达，就能做两件更大的事：一是读懂用百分比写的调查报告——把 ninety percent of them use the Internet every day 这类句子里的百分数和 always、usually、sometimes 对上号，就知道「九成学生天天上网」该怎么用英语说；二是写一份自己的好习惯坏习惯报告，每条都带上频度词：She always exercises. She hardly ever stays up late.。往后学了别的时态，How often 的问答骨架不变，换的只是动词——先把这套骨架搭牢。

methods.name: 频度阶梯定位法
steps: 把六档从高到低排好：always (100%) → usually → often → sometimes → hardly ever → never (0%)
给自己定位：天天做站 always，一周几次站 often，几乎不做站 hardly ever
说话时频度词放在实义动词前、be 动词后：I usually watch TV.／He is never late.
methods.tip: always 满勤 never 零，hardly ever 偶尔蹦；usually often 常见面，sometimes 站中间

methods.name: 次数加时间段报数法
steps: 记牢三个数词说法：一次 once、两次 twice、三次及以上用数字加 times
后面接时间段：once a week、twice a week、three times a month、every day
回答 How often 直接报短语，说不准加 maybe：I go to the movies maybe once a month.
methods.tip: 一 once 二 twice，三往上 times 排；a week a month 跟在后，报完次数任务完

examples.question: 把频度副词 never、always、hardly ever、usually 从高频到低频排序。
examples.solution: always > usually > hardly ever > never。always 是 100% 满勤，usually 惯常做，hardly ever 几乎不做，never 是 0%。
examples.pitfall: 把 hardly ever 排在 usually 旁边——它其实是「几乎不」，紧挨着 never。

examples.question: 补全对话：—How often does he watch TV?　—He ______ watches TV.（用「几乎不」对应的频度短语）
examples.solution: hardly ever。原句：He hardly ever watches TV. hardly ever 意思是 almost never，频度短语放在实义动词 watches 前，三单动词别忘了 s。
examples.pitfall: 理解反了填 often，或者三单漏了 s 写成 watch。

examples.question: 用英语报出频率：我每周上两次钢琴课。
examples.solution: I have piano lessons twice a week. 两次用 twice，后面接时间段 a week。
examples.pitfall: 写成 two times a week，或把 twice 拼错。

mistakes: twice 拼成 two time：两次用 twice，三次及以上才用 three times 这样的「数字+times」。
hardly ever 当「经常」：hardly ever 意思是 almost never 几乎不做，和 often 方向相反。
every day 连写：表示「每天」要分开写两个词；连写的 everyday 是形容词「日常的」。
三单漏勾 s：He hardly ever watches TV. 里 watches 的 s 不能丢，问句也要用 does 提问。

exercises.question: —How often do you go to the movies?　—______.　A. Maybe once a month　B. Last Sunday　C. It was wonderful
exercises.solution: How often 问频率，用次数短语回答：I go to the movies maybe once a month.；B 回答的是时间点，C 回答的是评价，都答非所问。

source.label: 人教新目标八上 P11·语法聚焦频度问答（How often do you go to the movies? I go to the movies maybe once a month.）

exercises.question: 补全对话：—How often do you have piano lessons?　—______.　A. Twice a week, on Wednesday and Friday　B. On Wednesday and Friday　C. My piano teacher is strict
options: Twice a week, on Wednesday and Friday
exercises.solution: 对话原句：How often do you have piano lessons? —Twice a week, on Wednesday and Friday. 问 How often 就要报次数；B 只说了哪两天，没报频率。

source.label: 人教新目标八上 P10·角色对话（How often do you have piano lessons? Twice a week, on Wednesday and Friday.）

exercises.question: 健康小调查里问 How often do you drink milk? 你每天喝。把回答补完整：I drink milk ______.
exercises.solution: 调查原对话：How often do you drink milk, Liu Fang? —I drink milk every day. every day 表示「每天」，分开写。

source.label: 人教新目标八上 P12·健康习惯问答（How often do you drink milk, Liu Fang? I drink milk every day.）变式（补全频度回答）

exercises.question: 给自己的一周做频率记录：挑锻炼、读书、帮做家务三件事，各写一句 How often 问句和带频度词或次数短语的回答，最后用六档频度词给自己的生活习惯定个位。
exercises.answer: 开放作答，如：—How often do you exercise? —I exercise three times a week.
exercises.solution: 问句用 How often do you…?，答句用频度词或 once / twice / three times a week 报数；主语换成三单时记得 does 和动词加 s。

lessons.summary: 比较级双轨制：短词加 -er、长词请 more，变 y 双写有规矩，good 变 better，as…as 不分高低。
explanation: 开场认双胞胎：Is that Sam? —No, that's Tom. Sam has longer hair than Tom. Both Sam and Tom can play the drums, but Sam plays them better than Tom. 反义词配对给出四组：tall—short、thin—heavy、long hair—short hair、loudly—quietly；对话练到另一对双胞胎：Tina is taller than Tara. And she also sings more loudly than Tara. 听力归类任务把形容词副词分成两轨——加 -(i)er 的和加 more 的，词表里有 funny、friendly、outgoing、hard-working、smart、lazy。唱歌比赛的角色对话是重头戏：I think Lisa sang better than Nelly. … The one with shorter hair. I think she sang more clearly than Nelly. … Nelly danced better than Lisa.。双人对比还有两句：Sam is smarter than Tom.／Tara works as hard as Tina.——后者就是同级比较 as…as：不分高低，中间夹原形。

比较级就是「把两个人或两样东西放上天平」。英语分两条轨道：短词自己加 -er 就行（taller、smarter），长词懒得变形，前面请个 more 来帮忙（more outgoing、more hard-working）；一部分双音节词（funny、friendly、heavy）走 -er 轨，但要先变词尾。句型骨架是「A + 比较级 + than + B」：I'm more outgoing than my sister.。如果两者不分高低，就用 as…as 把原形夹在中间：works as hard as Tina，意思是「和她一样努力」。

变形三步法：第一步数音节定轨道——单音节和部分双音节词加 -er（taller、shorter、smarter、quieter），多数双音节和多音节词加 more（more outgoing、more serious）；第二步查词尾用规则——辅音字母加 y 结尾的，变 y 为 i 再加 er（heavy→heavier、funny→funnier、friendly→friendlier），重读闭音节「辅元辅」结构的双写末尾字母再加 er（big→bigger、thin→thinner、hot→hotter）；第三步不规则成对硬记——good / well→better（Sam plays them better than Tom.、Lisa sang better than Nelly.）、bad→worse、many / much→more。造句时 than 后面的比较对象别丢：She sings more loudly than Tara.

四个雷区：一是双轨混搭——more taller、more smarter 都是错的，一条轨道走到底：要么 taller，要么 more beautiful；二是双写漏网——thin→thinner、big→bigger 末尾字母要双写，写成 thiner、biger 就错了；三是 as…as 中间必须用原形——as tall as、work as hard as，塞进比较级就成了 as taller as 的病句；四是形容词副词分家——形容「人」用 louder、quieter，修饰「唱、跑」这些动作用 more loudly、more clearly：she sings more loudly than Tara。

比较级是本学期写作的主力句型：写「我和我最好的朋友」这类作文，全靠 than 句和 as…as 句撑骨架——相同点用 both 和 as…as，不同点用比较级加 than。把三规则练熟，下一步的最高级就是在它们基础上再加一档（taller→the tallest），变形功夫一点不浪费。平时还可以玩「猜猜他是谁」：My hair is longer than his. He runs faster than me. 让同学猜你说的是谁，比较级立刻就活了。

methods.name: 双轨变形三步法
steps: 数音节定轨道：短词加 -er（taller、smarter、quieter），长词加 more（more outgoing、more serious）
查词尾用规则：辅音字母加 y 结尾变 y 为 i 加 er（heavy→heavier、funny→funnier、friendly→friendlier）；重读闭音节「辅元辅」双写末字母再加 er（big→bigger、thin→thinner、hot→hotter）
不规则成对硬记：good / well→better、bad→worse、many / much→more
methods.tip: 短词加 er 长词 more；y 变 i、双写要记牢；better worse 单独背

methods.name: than 句与 as…as 装配法
steps: 比出高低：A + be/动词 + 比较级 + than + B——I'm more outgoing than my sister.／Sam is smarter than Tom.
不分高低：as + 原形 + as——Tara works as hard as Tina.；要说「不如」就在前面加 not：not as tall as
副词比较级修饰动作：sing more loudly、dance better、run faster
methods.tip: 有高低找 than，不分高低 as…as 夹原形；修饰动作用副词级

examples.question: 写出 thin 的比较级，并说出它用了三条变形规则里的哪一条。
examples.solution: thin → thinner，用「重读闭音节双写末尾字母」规则：辅元辅结构双写 n 再加 er；同类还有 big→bigger、hot→hotter。
examples.pitfall: 漏了双写写成 thiner——末尾的 n 要写两个。

examples.question: 选一选：My cousin is ______ than me.　A. more outgoing　B. outgoinger　C. more outgoinger
examples.solution: A。outgoing 是多音节词，走 more 轨：more outgoing；-er 轨和 more 轨不能混搭，B、C 都是把两条轨道搅在一起。
examples.pitfall: 画蛇添足写出 more outgoinger 这类双重变形。

examples.question: 改错：He runs as faster as his brother.
examples.solution: as…as 中间用原形：He runs as fast as his brother. 对话里的同款结构是 Tara works as hard as Tina.。
examples.pitfall: 看见「跑得一样快」就顺手把 fast 变成 faster，忘了 as…as 夹的是原形。

mistakes: 双轨混搭：more taller、more smarter 都是错的——要么 taller，要么 more beautiful，两条轨道不同时走。
变 y 忘变形：heavy 的比较级是 heavier 不是 heavyer，辅音字母加 y 结尾要变 y 为 i 再加 er。
双写漏字：thin→thinner、big→bigger 末尾字母要双写，thiner、biger 都是拼错。
as…as 夹比较级：as…as 中间用形容词或副词原形——as tall as、as hard as，as taller as 不成立。

source.unit: Unit 3 I'm more outgoing than my sister.

exercises.question: —Is that Sam?　—No, that's Tom. Sam has ______ hair than Tom.　A. longer　B. long　C. longest
exercises.solution: 原句：Sam has longer hair than Tom. 两者相比用比较级加 than；long 是单音节词，直接加 er。

source.label: 人教新目标八上 P17·双胞胎辨认对话（Is that Sam? No, that's Tom. Sam has longer hair than Tom.）

exercises.question: 归类任务：funny、outgoing、smart 三个词里，比较级要在前面加 more 的是：　A. funny　B. outgoing　C. smart
exercises.solution: outgoing 是多音节词，加 more：more outgoing；funny→funnier（变 y）、smart→smarter（直接加 er）走 -er 轨。

source.label: 人教新目标八上 P18·比较级归类（-(i)er / more：funny、friendly、outgoing、hard-working、smart、lazy）

exercises.question: 对话里说 Tara works as hard as Tina.（Tara 和 Tina 一样努力）。仿写一句：我妹妹和我跑得一样快。
exercises.answer: My sister runs as fast as me.
exercises.solution: 同级比较用 as+原形+as；修饰「跑」这个动作用副词原形 fast，不能用 faster。

source.label: 人教新目标八上 P18·双人对比（Tara works as hard as Tina.）变式（as…as 同级仿写）

exercises.question: 以「我和我的好朋友」为题打三句草稿：两句用比较级加 than 写不同点，一句用 as…as 写相同点；双写、变 y 和不规则变形最好各用上一次。
exercises.answer: 开放作答，如：I'm taller than him, and he is funnier than me. We run as fast as each other.
exercises.solution: 不同点用比较级加 than，相同点用 as…as；写完对照三条变形规则逐句检查。

lessons.summary: 最高级选出冠军：the biggest screens、the most comfortable seats，the 的帽子不能丢，in 和 of 圈出比武范围。
explanation: 话题从「你挑哪家影院」开始，列出的考量有：comfortable seats、big screens、best sound、cheap、new movies、close to home、buy tickets quickly、popular。听力配对给出六条「之最」：It has the biggest screens.／It's the most popular near here.／It's the closest to home.／It has the shortest waiting time.／It has the best sound.／It has the most comfortable seats. 核心对话一问一答：What's the best movie theater? —Sun Cinema. It's the cheapest. —But I think Moon Theater has the most comfortable seats. 语法聚焦三组问答：What's the best movie theater to go to? —Town Cinema. It's the closest to home. And you can buy tickets the most quickly there.／Which is the worst clothes store in town? —Dream Clothes. It's worse than Blue Moon. It has the worst service.／What do you think of 970 AM? —I think 970 AM is pretty bad. It has the worst music. 新邻居对话补上一组：the best supermarket is on Center Street. You can buy the freshest food there. Sun Cinema is the newest one. You can sit the most comfortably. 才艺句：My cousin Li Jing is the funniest person I know. 写作例句：In my class, Tom is the best singer because he can sing fast songs very well.

比较级是两个人比，最高级是三个人以上选冠军。冠军榜上的词都要戴上 the 这顶帽子：the cheapest、the closest to home、the most comfortable seats。变形和比较级共用三规则：短词加 -est（shortest、newest、closest），y 变 i 加 est（funniest、heaviest），双写加 est（biggest、hottest）；长词用 the most（the most popular、the most expensive）。不规则的两个老朋友也跟着升顶：good / well→best、bad→worst。最后还要圈出比赛范围——in 加地点（in town、in my class、near here），of 加一组人或物（of the three），不说清楚范围，「冠军」就不知道是哪场比赛的冠军。

登顶三步：第一步变形——按三规则把词变成最高级：短词 cheap→cheapest、close→closest、new→newest，变 y 的 funny→funniest、heavy→heaviest，双写的 big→biggest，长音节的 popular→the most popular、comfortable→the most comfortable；第二步记不规则——good / well→best、bad→worse→worst，书上语法聚焦的 It's worse than Blue Moon. It has the worst service. 正好把比较、最高两级都演示了一遍；第三步配范围——in 加地点：the worst clothes store in town、the best supermarket on Center Street；of 加群体：the tallest of the three。副词也照此办理：buy tickets the most quickly there、sit the most comfortably。

四个易错点：一是 the 帽子忘戴——It's the cheapest. 里的 the 不能丢，最高级前面通常都要带 the；二是比较级最高级用串场合——两家店比用 worse than，三家以上才说 the worst store，书上正是先用 It's worse than Blue Moon. 再补 It has the worst service.；三是双写漏网——big→biggest、hot→hottest，写成 bigest 就错了；四是范围介词混用——in 后面接地点（in town、in my class），of 后面接一群同类（of the three），「我认识的最有趣的人」这类句子靠 I know 圈范围：the funniest person I know。

学会最高级，就能做两件实用的事：一是给家乡写「最佳榜单」——the best park、the most beautiful school，每条配一个 because 理由；二是在班里搞「之最」调查——the best chess player、the fastest runner，把调查结果写成句子。最高级还常和观点连用：I think…is the best…，先亮观点再给理由，正是后面议论表达的基本功。比较级和最高级是同一套变形规则的两级台阶，练熟 -er 就等于预定了 -est。

methods.name: 登顶三步法
steps: 按三规则变形：短词加 -est（cheapest、closest、newest），y 变 i 加 est（funniest、heaviest），重读闭音节双写（biggest、hottest）；长词加 the most（the most popular、the most comfortable）
不规则升级记牢：good / well→best、bad→worst
圈定范围：in 加地点（in town、in my class、near here）、of 加群体（of the three）
methods.tip: 短词 est 长词 most，good 变 best bad 变 worst；the 帽子戴头上，in 地点 of 群体圈赛场

methods.name: 冠军榜问答法
steps: 问冠军：What's the best movie theater?／Which is the worst clothes store in town?
报冠军再给证据：Sun Cinema. It's the cheapest.／It has the most comfortable seats.
两家先比、三家登顶：It's worse than Blue Moon. It has the worst service.
methods.tip: What's the best 开口问，the 加最高级报冠军，证据就用「最」字句

examples.question: 补全对话：—What's the best movie theater?　—Sun Cinema. It's ______.（从 the cheapest、cheapest、cheaper 里选）
examples.solution: the cheapest。最高级要戴 the：It's the cheapest.；cheaper 是比较级，用在两者比较的场合，接不上「最佳」的话头。
examples.pitfall: 丢掉 the 直接说 cheapest——冠军榜上的词要戴 the 的帽子。

examples.question: 写出 big 的最高级，并用它补全：It has the ______ screens.
examples.solution: big → biggest；It has the biggest screens. 重读闭音节「辅元辅」双写 g 再加 est。
examples.pitfall: 双写漏网写成 bigest。

examples.question: 选介词圈范围：Miller's is the best clothes store ______ town.／The tallest boy ______ the three is Peter.
examples.solution: in；of。in 圈地点范围（in town），of 圈一组同类（of the three）。
examples.pitfall: 两个介词随便换用——in town 说成 of town 就错了。

mistakes: the 帽子忘戴：最高级前面通常带 the——It's the cheapest. It has the best sound.，光秃秃的 cheapest 站不住。
场合用串：两者比较用比较级加 than（worse than Blue Moon），三者以上才用最高级（the worst store）。
双写漏网：big→biggest、hot→hottest、thin→thinnest，末尾字母要双写。
good/bad 硬变：good 的最高级是 best，bad 是 worst，goodest、badder 都不存在。

source.unit: Unit 4 What's the best movie theater?

exercises.question: —What's the best movie theater?　—Sun Cinema. ______　A. It's the cheapest.　B. It's cheaper.　C. It's cheap.
exercises.solution: 问句用最高级选冠军，回答也要用最高级：It's the cheapest.；B、C 只是描述便宜，接不上「最佳」的话题。
