exercises.question: 分类并应答：Could you take out the rubbish first? 这句属于 Requests（请求）还是 Permission（许可）？写出类别，再配一句合适应答。
exercises.answer: Requests；可答 Yes, sure.／No problem. 等
exercises.solution: 自测分类原题把 Could you take out the rubbish first? 放进 Requests 一栏——Could you…? 是请对方做事；应答用 Yes, sure.

source.label: 人教新目标八下 P24·自测请求与许可分类（Could you take out the rubbish first?）

exercises.question: 变式补全对话：—Could I watch TV?　—Yes, you can, but first ______.　A. you have to clean your room　B. I have to clean your room　C. you have cleaning your room
options: you have to clean your room
I have to clean your room
exercises.solution: 原句：Yes, you can, but first you have to clean your room.——许可附条件；主语是 you，have to 后接动词原形。

source.label: 人教新目标八下 P18·Could I 问答（Could I watch TV? Yes, you can, but first you have to clean your room.）变式（许可附带条件）

exercises.question: 周末大扫除：用 Could you please…? 向家人提一个请求，用 Could I…? 要一项许可，各配一句应答，写成四句小对话。
exercises.answer: 开放作答，如：—Could you please sweep the floor? —Yes, sure. —Could I go out after that? —Yes, you can, but first fold the clothes.
exercises.solution: 请求与许可各用一次；注意应答主语别搞反——Could I…? 的回答用 you。

lessons.summary: What's wrong? 问出烦恼，Why don't you…? 给出建议，until 到点、so that 图目的——把关心串成完整的话。
explanation: 开篇对话原句：What's wrong? — I'm really tired because I studied until midnight last night. — Why don't you go to sleep earlier this evening? 烦恼清单里有一条：My parents don't allow me to hang out with my friends. 语法聚焦四组：You look tired. What's the matter? — I studied until midnight last night so I didn't get enough sleep.／What should I do? — Why don't you forget about it? Although she's wrong, it's not a big deal.／What should he do? — He should talk to his friend so that he can say he's sorry.／Maybe you could go to his house. — I guess I could, but I don't want to surprise him. 选词练习把 although、so that、until 放进同一组对话：You shouldn't wait until the last minute to study for a test. 回信语篇里还有：Maybe you could do more jobs around the house so that they have more time for proper communication.／Why don't you sit down and communicate with your brother?

这部分聊的全是真实的烦恼：学习到半夜、和好朋友吵架、父母不许外出、兄弟姐妹乱翻自己的东西。用英文把烦恼说出来本身就是一种疏解——What's wrong?／What's the matter?／You look sad. 都是打开话匣子的钥匙；而给建议的三种说法各有脾气：Why don't you…? 最商量、You should… 最直接、You could… 给足选择。回信里那句 Although she's wrong, it's not a big deal. 也值得学——先让一步，矛盾才有台阶下。

连词分工要记牢：until 后面接时间——studied until midnight（学到半夜）、watch whatever he wants until late at night（看到深夜），表示「一直到」；so that 后面接完整句子（常带 can、will）——so that you can say you're sorry（好让你能道歉），表示「为了、以便」。开头问烦恼用 What's wrong?；给建议的完整链是：问一句烦恼→给一条建议→用 so that 说明这样做的好处。

易混点辨析：一是 until 与 so that 的选词——空格后面是时间点（midnight、late at night）选 until，后面是「能／会…」的句子选 so that；二是 so that 与 because 方向相反——so that 前是行动、后是目的，because 前是结果、后是原因；三是相处短语：get on with＝get along with「与……相处」（I can't get on with my family.），communicate with 侧重「沟通」（sit down and communicate with your brother.），allow sb to do sth「允许某人做某事」的 to 不能丢（don't allow me to hang out）。

这一串句型正是「给建议回信」类写作的骨架：先共情一句 It's not easy being your age.，再用 Why don't you…?／You could… 给建议，最后用 so that 说明好处——Maybe you could do more jobs around the house so that they have more time for proper communication. 就是现成的范本。把 until、so that 用准了，建议就既有温度又有条理。

methods.name: until 与 so that 选词法
steps: 看空格后面：是时间点或时间段——midnight、late at night，选 until
是带主语谓语的句子（常含 can、will）——so that you can say you're sorry，选 so that
代入检验：until＝「一直到」，so that＝「为了、以便」，意思通顺才算选对
methods.tip: until 到点 so that 为目的

methods.name: 建议三句式升级法
steps: 先问烦恼：What's wrong?／What's the matter?／You look sad.
再给建议：Why don't you talk to your parents?（＝You should talk to your parents.）
补上目的或宽心话：so that you can be friends again.／Although she's wrong, it's not a big deal.
methods.tip: Why don't you 最商量，should 稳当 could 缓

methods.name: 相处短语对照法
steps: get on with＝get along with「与……相处」：I can't get on with my family.
communicate with「与……沟通」：sit down and communicate with your brother.
allow sb to do sth「允许某人做某事」：My parents don't allow me to hang out with my friends.
methods.tip: 相处 get on，沟通 communicate，允许 allow 带 to

examples.question: 选词填空：You shouldn't wait ______ the last minute to study for a test.（until / so that）
examples.solution: 填 until。原句：You shouldn't wait until the last minute to study for a test.——the last minute 是时间点，「等到最后一刻」用 until。
examples.pitfall: 空格后 the last minute 是时间，不是目的句，填 so that 讲不通。

examples.question: 选词填空：You should eat more now ______ you won't be hungry later.（until / so that / although）
examples.solution: 填 so that。原句：You should eat more now so that you won't be hungry later.——空格后是带主语谓语的完整句，表目的「以便晚点不饿」。
examples.pitfall: 别被 although 干扰——although 表「尽管」，放这里意思正好拧了。

examples.question: 同义句改写：Why don't you go to sleep earlier this evening?（改为以 You should 开头的同义句）
examples.solution: You should go to sleep earlier this evening. Why don't you＋动词原形…? 与 You should＋动词原形. 意思相近，都是给建议。
examples.pitfall: 改写后动词保持原形——go to sleep earlier，别变成 goes 或 going。

mistakes: Why don't you 后接动词原形：Why don't you talk to your parents? 不能写成 Why don't you to talk…。
so that 后面必须是完整句子（常含 can、will、won't），until 后面通常只接时间——两个连词互换，句子就不通了。
allow sb to do sth 的 to 不能丢：My parents don't allow me to hang out with my friends. 不是 allow me hang out。
not…until 是「直到……才」，和肯定句的 until「一直到」意思不同：I didn't go to bed until midnight.＝半夜十二点才睡。

source.unit: Unit 4 Why don't you talk to your parents?

exercises.question: 补全对话：—What's wrong?　—I'm really tired because I studied ______ midnight last night.　A. until　B. so that　C. although
exercises.solution: 原句：I studied until midnight last night.——midnight 是时间点，「学到半夜」用 until。

source.label: 人教新目标八下 P25·烦恼对话（What's wrong? I studied until midnight last night.）

exercises.question: 用 should 和 so that 补全建议：You ______ talk to him ______ you can say you're sorry.
exercises.solution: 原句：You should talk to him so that you can say you're sorry.——should 给建议，so that 带出目的「好让你能道歉」。

source.label: 人教新目标八下 P26·建议填空（You should talk to him so that you can say you're sorry.）

exercises.question: 变式选词：Kids shouldn't play computer games ______ late at night.　A. so that　B. until　C. because
exercises.solution: 原句：Kids shouldn't play computer games until late at night.——late at night 是时间，用 until「玩到深夜」；shouldn't…until 表示「不该……到」。

source.label: 人教新目标八下 P32·自测 until/so that/although 选词（Kids shouldn't play computer games until late at night.）变式（时间连词辨析）

exercises.question: 好朋友因为和弟弟吵架而不开心：用 What's wrong? 开头问一句，用 Why don't you…? 给一条建议，再用 so that 说明这样做的好处，写三句连贯的话。
exercises.answer: 开放作答，如：—What's wrong? —Why don't you sit down and talk to him? —Talk to him so that you can understand each other.
exercises.solution: 建议＋目的连词是回信的常用骨架：Why don't you…? 出主意，so that 说好处。

lessons.summary: What were you doing when the rainstorm came?——was/were+V-ing 回放过去画面，while 长动作、when 短动作。
explanation: 语法聚焦五组问答：What were you doing at eight last night? — I was taking a shower.／What was she doing at the time of the rainstorm? — She was doing her homework.／What was he doing when the rainstorm came? — He was reading in the library when the rainstorm came.／What was Ben doing when it began to rain heavily? — When it began to rain, Ben was helping his mom make dinner.／What was Jenny doing while Linda was sleeping? — While Linda was sleeping, Jenny was helping Mary with her homework. 改写练习给出同义双句：While John was taking photos, Mary bought a drink.＝John was taking photos when Mary bought a drink. 语篇「暴风雨把人们拉得更近」里满是这样的句子：Ben's dad was putting pieces of wood over the windows while his mom was making sure the flashlights and radio were working.／Ben was helping his mom make dinner when the rain began to beat heavily against the windows.
过去进行时像「回放录像」：把时间拨回昨天晚上八点，那一刻正在进行的动作就是 I was taking a shower.。暴风雨来的那一刻，有人在图书馆看书，有人在帮妈妈做饭——「正在」就是这个时态的灵魂。突发动作（雨来了、电话响了）像快门咔嚓一声，用一般过去时；背景动作像长镜头，用过去进行时。两种时态一搭，故事立刻有了画面感。

搭积木两步走：第一步选 be——主语 I、he、she、it 配 was，you、we、they 配 were；第二步变 V-ing——一般直接加 -ing（do→doing），去 e 加 -ing（take→taking），重读闭音节双写（run→running）。拼起来：I was taking a shower.／They were playing basketball.；问句把 was／were 提到主语前：What were you doing…?；否定在 was／were 后加 not。连接词分工：when 常引出短动作或突发一刻，while 后面通常接进行中的长动作。

易混三处：一是 was／were 别配错——He was reading in the library. 对，He were reading 错；二是 while 与 when 选词——While Linda was sleeping,…（进行中的长动作），…when the rainstorm came（突发一刻）；同一件事可以两种说法：While John was taking photos, Mary bought a drink.＝John was taking photos when Mary bought a drink.；三是别丢 be 动词——I was taking a shower. 不能说成 I taking a shower。
过去进行时是「讲故事、写报道」的主力时态：突发事件报道的结构就是「时间＋当时正在做什么＋突然发生什么」——At eight last night, I was doing my homework when the phone rang. 把它和一般过去时配合好，写日记、写叙事作文就能把「背景画面」和「突发事件」分得清清楚楚。习惯养成：每晚睡前用两句话回放今天，练的就是这对老搭档。

methods.name: 过去进行时搭积木法
steps: 第一步选 be：主语 I/he/she/it 用 was，you/we/they 用 were
第二步变 V-ing：do→doing、take→taking（去 e）、run→running（双写）
拼装成句：I was taking a shower.／They were playing basketball.；问句把 was/were 提到主语前
methods.tip: I was 你 were，动词尾巴加 ing

methods.name: while 与 when 选词法
steps: while 后接进行中的长动作：While Linda was sleeping, Jenny was helping Mary with her homework.
when 后常接短动作或突发一刻：He was reading in the library when the rainstorm came.
同类句可互换：While John was taking photos, Mary bought a drink.＝John was taking photos when Mary bought a drink.
methods.tip: while 长动作 when 短动作

methods.name: 突发事件叙事框架
steps: 先铺背景（过去进行时）：Ben was helping his mom make dinner
再点突发（一般过去时）：when the rain began to beat heavily against the windows
最后补结果：After dinner, they tried to play a card game…／the neighborhood in a mess
methods.tip: 长镜头用进行时，快门一响过去时

examples.question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：—What were you doing at eight last night?　—I ______ (take) a shower.
examples.solution: 填 was taking。语法聚焦原句：What were you doing at eight last night? — I was taking a shower.——主语 I 配 was，take 去 e 加 ing。
examples.pitfall: 别只写 took——问的是「那一刻正在做」，要用过去进行时 was taking。

examples.question: 选词填空：______ Linda was sleeping, Jenny was helping Mary with her homework.（When / While）
examples.solution: 填 While。原句：While Linda was sleeping, Jenny was helping Mary with her homework.——两个长动作同时进行，用 while。
examples.pitfall: while 后接 was sleeping 这样的进行时；接突发短动作时才优先考虑 when。

examples.question: 单选：The rainstorm came when we ______ dinner.　A. have　B. had　C. were having
examples.solution: 选 C。雨「来」是突发短动作（一般过去时 came），「正在吃晚饭」是背景长动作，用过去进行时 were having；主语 we 配 were。
examples.pitfall: 别选 had——一般过去时只说「吃过」，表达不出「正在吃」的画面感。

mistakes: 过去进行时不能丢 be 动词：I was taking a shower. 不是 I taking a shower——was/were 是这个时态的骨架。
was/were 要和主语配套：he/she/it/I 用 was，you/we/they 用 were——She were sleeping 是硬伤。
V-ing 变化别偷懒：take 去 e 加 ing 变 taking，run 双写 n 变 running，直接加 ing 的如 do→doing、read→reading。
while 与 when 别乱放：while 后接进行中的长动作，when 常引出突发的短动作——While the rainstorm came 这种说法就不对。

source.unit: Unit 5 What were you doing when the rainstorm came?

exercises.question: 补全对话：—What ______ she doing at the time of the rainstorm?　—She ______ doing her homework.　A. was; was　B. were; was　C. was; were
exercises.solution: 语法聚焦原句：What was she doing at the time of the rainstorm? — She was doing her homework.——主语 she 是单数，两处都用 was。

source.label: 人教新目标八下 P36·语法聚焦过去进行时问答（What was she doing at the time of the rainstorm? She was doing her homework.）

exercises.question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：Ben's dad ______ (put) pieces of wood over the windows while his mom was making sure the flashlights and radio were working.
exercises.solution: 语篇原句：Ben's dad was putting pieces of wood over the windows while his mom was making sure the flashlights and radio were working.——while 两边都是进行中的长动作，dad 单数用 was putting。

source.label: 人教新目标八下 P35·暴风雨之夜语篇（Ben's dad was putting pieces of wood over the windows while his mom was making sure…）

exercises.question: 变式选择：While John was taking photos, Mary bought a drink. 与下面哪句意思相同？A. John was taking photos when Mary bought a drink.　B. John took photos when Mary was buying a drink.　C. John was taking photos while Mary bought a drink.
options: John was taking photos when Mary bought a drink.
John took photos when Mary was buying a drink.
John was taking photos while Mary bought a drink.
exercises.solution: 改写原句：John was taking photos when Mary bought a drink.——长动作（拍照）用进行时作背景，短动作（买饮料）用 when 引出；while 与 when 在这类句子里可以互换位置。

source.label: 人教新目标八下 P36·while 与 when 同义改写（While John was taking photos, Mary bought a drink.）变式（when 与 while 互换）

exercises.question: 昨天傍晚突然下起大雨。用过去进行时写你当时正在做的事，再用一般过去时写雨突然下起来，最后写一句你是怎么应对的，组成三句小报道。
exercises.answer: 开放作答，如：At about six, I was walking home. Suddenly the rain began to fall heavily. I ran into a shop and waited for the rain to stop.
exercises.solution: 报道三段式：背景（was/were+V-ing）→突发（一般过去时）→应对，正是叙事作文的基本骨架。

lessons.summary: 学会用英语讲中国故事：Once upon a time 开场，as soon as 承接情节，instead of 说改道，还能介绍会七十二变的 the Monkey King。
explanation: 书上这部分从四个故事标题起步：Journey to the West（西游记）、Yu Gong Moves a Mountain（愚公移山）、Hou Yi Shoots the Suns（后羿射日）、Nu Wa Repairs the Sky（女娲补天）。愚公的故事先抓三件事实：The two mountains were very high and big. A very old man tried to move the mountains. A man told Yu Gong that he could never do it. 语法聚焦把讲故事问答定型：How does the story begin? —Once upon a time, there was a very old man. What happened next? —As soon as the man finished talking, Yu Gong said that his family could continue to move the mountains after he died. 猴王语段再补一笔：he can make 72 changes to his shape and size, turning himself into different animals and objects. But unless he can hide his tail, he cannot turn himself into a man.

为什么用这几个词讲故事？Once upon a time 是万能开场白，等于中文的「从前」；as soon as 是情节传送带，表示「一……就……」，前一幕刚结束，后一幕立刻接上；instead of 是故事的岔路口，表示「不做这件，改做那件」；a little bit silly 则是评故事时的看法表达——课上的对话里，有人觉得愚公 it's a little bit silly（有点傻），也有人坚信 anything is possible if you work hard。讲故事和评故事，这几件工具就够了。

讲一个故事可以走三步：第一步开场，用 Once upon a time, there was…交代人物背景；第二步推进，用 as soon as 把事件串起来——As soon as the man finished talking, Yu Gong said…，从句用一般过去时；第三步收尾，用 This story reminds us that…（这个故事提醒我们……）点出道理。中间要写「变身」就用 turn…into…：turn himself into different animals and objects（把自己变成不同的动物和物品）；要写「继续做某事」就用 continue to do：continue to move the mountains。

三个易混点要分清：一是 instead of 后面的动词要加 -ing——instead of moving the mountains（而不是移山），不能说 instead of move；二是 as soon as 和 unless 功能不同：as soon as 管「时间上一……就……」，unless 管「条件上除非」——Unless he can hide his tail, he cannot turn himself into a man（除非藏起尾巴，否则变不成人）；三是 turn into 不是 turn on：turn himself into a man 是「变成一个人」，turn on 是「打开（电器）」，意思天差地别。

这套讲故事工具是通用的：接着还能讲剧本式的故事《糖果屋》（Hansel and Gretel），里面同样满是 as soon as（As soon as the moon rises, we can follow them instead）和 unless（Unless we do, we won't find our way out）。用英语讲中国故事还能当文化小使者：语段里说，三十多年前一档电视节目一播出，西方孩子就迷上了 the clever Monkey King，因为他 keeps fighting to help the weak and never gives up——把中国的故事讲给世界听，就从这几句开始。

methods.name: 讲故事三步套
steps: 第一步开场：Once upon a time, there was…（从前有……）
第二步推进：as soon as＋从句，一幕接一幕（As soon as the man finished talking, …）
第三步收尾：This story reminds us that…（这个故事提醒我们……）
需要变身加 turn…into…，需要「继续做」加 continue to do
methods.tip: 口诀：Once upon a time 开场，as soon as 接戏，reminds us 收尾。

methods.name: instead of 岔路口
steps: 找到原计划：moving the mountains（移山）
找到替代方案：build a road（修路）
用 instead of 连接：instead of moving the mountains
检查 of 后面的动词加 -ing
methods.tip: 口诀：instead of 不选它，of 后动词穿 ing。

methods.name: as soon as 与 unless 分工法
steps: 先问：这句话说时间还是说条件？
说「一……就……」→ as soon as
说「除非……否则不……」→ unless
两个从句里都不用 will，讲过去的事就用过去时
methods.tip: 口诀：as soon as 抢时间，unless 卡条件。

examples.question: 补全句子：____ the prince saw her, he fell in love with her. 横线上用 As soon as 还是 Unless？
examples.solution: 用 As soon as。句子说的是「王子一见到她，就爱上了她」，前一动作发生、后一动作立刻跟上，是典型的时间关系；这正是连词选词练习里的原句。
examples.pitfall: 顺手填 Unless——unless 表「除非」，接条件；这里是「一看见就爱上」，时间上的紧接。

examples.question: 课上的对话问：But what could Yu Gong do instead of ____ the mountains? 横线上填 move、moving 还是 to move？
examples.solution: 填 moving。instead of 里的 of 是介词，后面的动词要加 -ing：instead of moving the mountains（不移山，而做别的）。对话里给出的替代方案是 he could build a road（修条路）。
examples.pitfall: 写成 instead of move——of 是介词，后面动词必须加 -ing。

examples.question: 介绍 the Monkey King 的本领：He can turn himself ____ different animals and objects. 横线上填 into 还是 on？
examples.solution: 填 into。turn himself into…表示「把自己变成……」，语段原句是 turning himself into different animals and objects（能七十二变）；turn on 只表示「打开」。
examples.pitfall: 把 turn into（变成）和 turn on（打开）弄混——变身用 into。

mistakes: instead of 后面的动词忘加 -ing：要说 instead of moving the mountains，不能说 instead of move。
as soon as 从句里误用将来时：As soon as he comes back, we'll start（他一回来我们就开始），从句用一般现在时，不写 will come。
turn into 与 turn on 混用：turn himself into a man 是「变成人」，turn on 是「打开」，用错意思全变。
continue to do 丢掉 to：Yu Gong said his family could continue to move the mountains，to 后面接动词原形，不能光写 continue move。

source.unit: Unit 6 An old man tried to move the mountains.

exercises.question: —____ the man finished talking, Yu Gong said that his family could continue to move the mountains after he died.
exercises.solution: 原句是 As soon as the man finished talking, Yu Gong said…——那人一说完，愚公就说……，表示「一……就……」；instead of 后不接从句，unless 表条件，so that 表目的，意思都不通。

source.label: 人教新目标八下 P42·愚公移山听力句（As soon as the man finished talking, Yu Gong said that his family could continue to move the mountains after he died.）

exercises.question: Journey to the West（《西游记》）里的主角是谁？
exercises.solution: 语段原句：The Monkey King or Sun Wukong is the main character in the traditional Chinese book Journey to the West.——猴王孙悟空是主角；Yu Gong 是《愚公移山》的主人公，Hou Yi 射日，Nu Wa 补天。

source.label: 人教新目标八下 P41·四则故事标题配对（Journey to the West / Yu Gong Moves a Mountain / Hou Yi Shoots the Suns / Nu Wa Repairs the Sky）

exercises.question: He cannot turn himself into a man ____ he can hide his tail.
exercises.solution: 原句：He cannot turn himself into a man unless he can hide his tail.——除非他能藏住尾巴，否则没法把自己变成人；unless 引导条件，「除非……否则不……」。

source.label: 人教新目标八下 P44·语法聚焦连词选词填空（unless / as soon as / so...that；He cannot turn himself into a man unless he can hide his tail.）变式（unless 条件句辨析）

exercises.question: 用讲故事三步套给《守株待兔》编一个英文开头：先写 Once upon a time 交代农夫，再用 as soon as 写兔子撞上树桩后农夫做了什么。
exercises.answer: 示例：Once upon a time, there was a farmer. As soon as he saw a rabbit crash into the tree stump, he picked it up and went home.
exercises.solution: 三步套：Once upon a time 开场交代人物，as soon as 从句写「一……就……」的紧接动作，从句用一般过去时；想更进一步，还可以用 instead of waiting（不干等）写农夫本该做什么。

lessons.summary: 学会用英语报地理之最：What's the highest mountain in the world? 问冠军，8,844.43 meters high 报数字，much older than 比差距。
explanation: 语法聚焦的地理问答是这部分的主干：What's the highest mountain in the world? —Qomolangma. How high is Qomolangma? —It's 8,844.43 meters high. It's higher than any other mountain. Which is the deepest salt lake in the world? —The Caspian Sea is the deepest of all the salt lakes. Did you know that China is one of the oldest countries in the world? —Yes, I did. It's much older than the US. 听力材料再补两条硬核数据：The Yangtze River is about 6,300 kilometers long and the Yellow River is 5,464 kilometers long. 以及 China is over 5,000 years old. It has a much longer history than the US.

英语量东西有一套「数词＋单位＋方向词」的标尺：meters high 竖着量（山的高度），kilometers long 横着量（河的长度），meters deep 往下量（湖的深度）。8,844.43 读作 eight thousand, eight hundred and forty-four point four three，千位逗号是分节号。比较差距时，中文说「老得多」，英文用 much older；差距小用 a little；成倍差用 many times——程度词就是差距的刻度尺。

介绍一个地理之最走三步：第一步问冠军，What's the highest mountain in the world? —Qomolangma.；第二步报数字，It's 8,844.43 meters high.（数词＋单位＋方向词，放在 be 动词后）；第三步比差距，It's higher than any other mountain. 或 It's much older than the US.。想表达「最……之一」就用 one of the＋最高级＋复数名词：China is one of the oldest countries in the world. The Amazon River is one of the longest rivers in the world.

三个坑要绕开：一是 much、a lot、many times、a little 能修饰比较级，very、more 不能——说 much older、a lot bigger，不说 very older；二是 higher than any other mountain 里 any other 后接单数，意思是把比较对象里的自己排除在外（比其他任何一座山都高）；三是 as…as 中间用原级：China is almost as big as the US（中国几乎和美国一样大），No ocean in the world is as big as the Pacific Ocean（没有哪个大洋有太平洋大）——中间夹的是 big，不是 bigger。

这套「冠军＋数字＋差距」的介绍法马上能派上用场：长城的导游词就是这么搭的——it's about 8,850 kilometers long. This makes it the longest wall in the world.（这使它成为世界上最长的墙）。随后的阅读还会用数字讲大熊猫：野生大熊猫不足 2,000 只，成年熊猫每天花 12 个多小时吃约 10 公斤竹子——「数词＋单位＋方向词」的标尺，从地理一直量到动物保护。

methods.name: 地理之最三步介绍法
steps: 第一步问冠军：What's the highest mountain in the world? —Qomolangma.
第二步报数字：It's 8,844.43 meters high.（数词＋单位＋方向词）
第三步比差距：It's higher than any other mountain. / It's much older than the US.
methods.tip: 口诀：一问冠军，二报数字，三比高低。

methods.name: 数词单位方向词标尺法
steps: 竖着量用 high：8,844.43 meters high（山高）
横着量用 long：6,300 kilometers long（河长）
往下量用 deep：1,025 meters deep（湖深）
说面积用 in size：about 9,600,000 square kilometers in size
methods.tip: 口诀：high 竖 long 横 deep 往下量，面积结尾 in size。

methods.name: 差距刻度尺法
steps: 差距大：much / a lot＋比较级（much older than the US）
成倍差：many times＋比较级（weighs many times more than）
差距小：a little＋比较级（a little longer than the Yangtze River）
自检：very、more 不能修饰比较级
methods.tip: 口诀：much 大 little 小，many times 倍数到。

examples.question: How high is Qomolangma? —It's 8,844.43 meters ____. 横线上填 high、tall 还是 highly？
examples.solution: 填 high。数词＋单位＋high 是高度固定表达（It's 8,844.43 meters high.），山和建筑都用 high 不用 tall；highly 是副词「高度地」，不能搭单位。
examples.pitfall: 写成 meters tall——人的身高用 tall，山和建筑的高度表达是数词＋单位＋high。

examples.question: China is over 5,000 years old, and the US is not even 300 years old. So China is ____ older than the US. 横线上选 much 还是 a little？
examples.solution: 选 much。五千多年对比不到三百年，差距悬殊，用 much older（老得多）；a little 表示差距很小。语法聚焦原句正是 It's much older than the US.
examples.pitfall: 选 a little——差距刻度要看数字：五千对三百是悬殊差距，该用 much。

examples.question: 补全句子：Did you know that China is one of ____ in the world? 横线上选 the oldest countries、the oldest country 还是 older countries？
examples.solution: 选 the oldest countries。one of the＋最高级＋复数名词，表示「最……之一」：China is one of the oldest countries in the world.——「之一」从群体里挑，用复数 countries，the 别丢。
examples.pitfall: 选单数 the oldest country——one of 后面必须跟复数名词。

mistakes: 用 very 或 more 修饰比较级：要说 much older、a lot bigger，very 只修饰原级和最高级。
山高写成 meters tall：固定表达是数词＋单位＋high（8,844.43 meters high），tall 一般用于人的身高。
one of the＋最高级后面接单数名词：要说 one of the oldest countries，one of 后面必须是复数。
higher than any other mountain 里 any other 后用了复数：any other 后接单数 mountain，比较时先把自己排除。

source.unit: Unit 7 What's the highest mountain in the world?

exercises.question: —What's the highest mountain in the world? —____
exercises.solution: 语法聚焦原句：What's the highest mountain in the world? —Qomolangma.——世界最高的山是珠穆朗玛峰；the Nile 是最长的河，the Caspian Sea 是盐湖里最深的，the Sahara 是最大的沙漠。

source.label: 人教新目标八下 P52·语法聚焦地理问答（What's the highest mountain in the world? Qomolangma. How high is Qomolangma? It's 8,844.43 meters high.）

exercises.question: —How long is the Yangtze River? —It's about ____ kilometers long.
exercises.solution: 听力原句：The Yangtze River is about 6,300 kilometers long and the Yellow River is 5,464 kilometers long.——长江约 6,300 千米长；5,464 是黄河的长度，8,850 是长城明代部分的长度。

source.label: 人教新目标八下 P50·长江黄河长度听力（The Yangtze River is about 6,300 kilometers long and the Yellow River is 5,464 kilometers long.）

exercises.question: A cat eats only a little food, but an adult panda can eat about 10 kilos of bamboo a day. So an adult panda eats ____ more than a cat.
exercises.solution: 自测原句：An adult panda can eat (much / a little) more than a cat.——成年熊猫的饭量远超猫，差距大用 much more；few 不能修饰比较级。

source.label: 人教新目标八下 P56·自测程度词圈词（An adult panda can eat much more than a cat. A tiger is much stronger than a man.）变式（much/a little 差距判断）

exercises.question: 用「一问冠军，二报数字，三比高低」三步法，把长城介绍给外国朋友：已知长城约 8,850 kilometers long，是世界上最长的墙。写出你的三句话。
exercises.answer: 示例：How long is the Great Wall? It's about 8,850 kilometers long. It's the longest wall in the world.
exercises.solution: 三步套：先设问引出话题，再用数词＋单位＋long 报长度，最后用最高级 the longest wall in the world 点出冠军地位；书上导游词的原句 This makes it the longest wall in the world. 也可以直接借用。

lessons.summary: 学会问读没读过：Have you read Treasure Island yet? 读完用 already，还没读完用 yet，have 加过去分词一步到位。
explanation: 这部分围绕读书经历展开，主角句型是：A: Have you read Little Women yet? B: No, I haven't. Have you? A: Yes, I've already read it. B: What's it like? A: It's fantastic. 语法聚焦把问答补齐：Has Tina read Treasure Island yet? —Yes, she has. She thinks it's fantastic. Have you decided which book to write about yet? —Yes, I have. I've already finished reading it. 鲁滨逊的语段里满是完成时：I've found the ship and made a small boat. 以及 I have already cut down trees and built a house. 还有 I have already taught him some English.
现在完成时说的是「过去做的事，现在留下了痕迹」：书读完了，现在可以聊感想；树砍倒了，房子建起来了，现在有地方住。already 是「已经」，站在肯定句里报喜；yet 是「还（没）」，站在疑问句和否定句的句尾——问别人读没读过用 yet，说自己还没读完也用 yet：I haven't finished reading it yet.（我还没读完呢。）

搭一个完成时句子走三步：第一步选 have 或 has——主语是 he、she、Tina 这类第三人称单数用 has，其余用 have；第二步把动词变成过去分词，放在 have/has 后面；第三步摆位置——already 放在 have/has 和分词中间（I've already read it），yet 放在句尾（Have you read it yet? / I haven't read it yet.）。简短回答用 Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.，第三人称用 Yes, she has. / No, she hasn't.

最容易错的是过去分词的形态：read 是「三态同形」词——read-read-read，拼写不变，过去分词还是 read（I've read it three times.）；cut、put 也是这一家：cut-cut-cut、put-put-put，千万别写成 cutted、puted。不规则动词则各有各的分词：find-found-found、make-made-made、lose-lost-lost。另外 already 和 yet 不换岗：already 待在肯定句，yet 待在疑问句和否定句，写 I haven't read it already 就错了。

这是现在完成时的第一站：这里练「读了没、做了没」，接着会升级成「去过没」（Have you ever been to…?），再往后学 for 加时间段、since 加时间点（I've had this bike for three years.）说明动作延续了多久。写读书报告也能直接用：I've already finished reading it! It was really good, so I couldn't put it down.（读完了！太好看了，简直放不下来。）

methods.name: 完成时三步搭句法
steps: 第一步选助动词：I/you/we/they 用 have，he/she/人名用 has
第二步变分词：动词过去分词放在 have/has 后面
第三步摆位置：already 放 have/has 与分词之间，yet 放句尾
简答对齐：Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.（三单用 has）
methods.tip: 口诀：have has 打头阵，动词变身过去分词。

methods.name: already yet 定位法
steps: 肯定句报「已经」：I've already read it.（already 居中）
疑问句问「还没吧」：Have you read it yet?（yet 句尾）
否定句报「还没」：I haven't finished reading it yet.
互检：already 不进否定句，yet 不进肯定句
methods.tip: 口诀：already 肯定句中站，yet 在问否句尾藏。

methods.name: 三态同形归类法
steps: read-read-read：拼写不变，读音变（过去分词读 /red/）
cut-cut-cut、put-put-put：原样三连
变形别画蛇添足：没有 cutted、puted
同类扩展：let-let-let、hit-hit-hit
methods.tip: 口诀：read cut put 三胞胎，三态同形不用改。

examples.question: 补全句子：I've ____ finished reading Little Women. 横线上填 already 还是 yet？
examples.solution: 填 already。这是肯定句，报「已经读完」，already 放在 have 和分词 finished 中间；yet 只出现在疑问句和否定句的句尾。
examples.pitfall: 填 yet——yet 是疑问句、否定句的专属词，肯定句里报「已经」要用 already。

examples.question: —Has Tina read Treasure Island yet? 从下面三句里选正确的回答：Yes, she has. She thinks it's fantastic. / Yes, she did. / Yes, she is.
examples.solution: 选第一句。完成时的简短回答重复助动词：Has she…? 用 Yes, she has.——语法聚焦原句就是 Yes, she has. She thinks it's fantastic.；she did 是过去时的回答，she is 对应 be 动词，都对不上。
examples.pitfall: 选 Yes, she did.——问句助动词是 has，回答要用 has 呼应，不能跳回过去时。

examples.question: Robinson Crusoe 语段：I have already ____ down trees and built a house. 横线上 cut 的正确形式是什么？
examples.solution: 还是 cut。cut 是三态同形动词：cut-cut-cut，过去分词不变，I have already cut down trees and built a house.（我已经砍倒树木、建起了房子）；写成 cutted 就错了。
examples.pitfall: 写 cutted——read、cut、put 这类三态同形动词，过去分词和原形拼写完全一样。

mistakes: 三单主语漏用 has：She has read…、Tina has decided…，不能一律用 have。
already 误放进否定句：还没读完要说 I haven't finished reading it yet，already 不进否定句。
三态同形动词乱变形：read、cut、put 的过去分词拼写不变，没有 cutted、puted。
简短回答错位：Have you read…? 答 Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.，不答 Yes, I did。

source.unit: Unit 8 Have you read Treasure Island yet?

exercises.question: —Have you read Little Women yet? —Yes, I've ____ read it.
exercises.solution: 肯定句报「已经读过」，用 I've already read it.——already 放在 have 与分词之间；yet 属于疑问句和否定句，ever、never 是经历问答里的词。

source.label: 人教新目标八下 P57·读书对话（Have you read Little Women yet? No, I haven't. Have you? Yes, I've already read it. It's fantastic.）

exercises.question: —Have you read Little Women yet? —____
exercises.solution: 完成时问句用 have/has 呼应作答：No, I haven't.——didn't、don't、'm not 分别属于过去时、一般现在时和 be 动词，都对不上号。

source.label: 人教新目标八下 P60·语法聚焦完成时问答（Have you read Little Women yet? Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.）

exercises.question: Tony has bought a pop music CD, but he hasn't listened to it ____.
exercises.solution: 否定句句尾用 yet：He hasn't listened to it yet.（他买了 CD 但还没听）——自测原题正是 already 与 yet 的对照：肯定句 have read five books already，否定句 hasn't listened to it yet。

source.label: 人教新目标八下 P64·自测动词形式填空（I have read five books already. He has bought a CD but he hasn't listened to it yet.）变式（already/yet 选填）

exercises.question: 用完成时汇报你的读书进度：已经读完的书用 already 说一句，还没读完的书用 yet 说一句，再用 What's it like? 问一句同伴的读后感。
exercises.answer: 示例：I've already finished reading Tom Sawyer. I haven't finished reading Robinson Crusoe yet. Have you read it yet? What's it like?
exercises.solution: 肯定句 already 居中报「已经」，否定句句尾 yet 报「还没」，追问读后感用 What's it like?——这三句就是读书对话的完整闭环，还能加一句 It's fantastic. 发表感想。

lessons.summary: 学会聊去过哪儿：Have you ever been to a museum? been to 说去过，never been to 说没去过，Me neither 接「我也没有」。
explanation: 开头的对话就是模板：Have you ever been to a science museum? —Yes, I have. I went to the National Science Museum last year. Have you ever been to a history museum? —No, I haven't. —Me neither. Let's go to one tomorrow. 要逛的场所一排排摆好：history museum、space museum、art museum、water park、amusement park。语法聚焦把经历表达收拢：Yes, I've been to a science museum. / No, I've never been to a science museum.；I've been to the art museum many times. —Me, too. And I've also visited the nature museum.；I've never been to a water park. —Me neither.
问经历就像翻人生打卡册：ever 问「到目前为止有没有过」，never 说「一次也没有」。完成时只管「有没有这个经历」，细节要用过去时补——I went there last year.（去年去的）就是答完经历后追加的一笔。同伴说没去过，你也没去过，就接 Me neither.（我也没去过），顺势还能约一句 Let's go to one tomorrow.

经历问答三步走：第一步问——Have＋主语＋ever＋been to＋地点?（Have you ever been to the space museum?）；第二步答——去过用 Yes, I have. I've been there many times.，从没去过用 No, I haven't. I've never been there. 或干脆 Me neither.；第三步补细节——用一般过去时报时间：I went there last year. / I went there back in April.（四月里去的那次）。说次数用 many times、once、three times，直接放句尾。

两组搭配要分清：一是 been to 和 gone to——been to 表示「去过，人已经回来」（I've been to the art museum many times.），gone to 表示「去了，人还没回来」（He has gone to the amusement park，人还在乐园里）；聊经历用 been，说人此刻不在用 gone。二是 ever 和 never 的位置——都放在主语后、过去分词前；ever 只出现在疑问句（Have you ever…?），never 本身带否定，直接说 I've never been there，别再加 not。三是应答的分工——对方说去过你附和 Me, too.，对方说没去过你回应 Me neither.，两句不能互换。
经历问答的题材越铺越宽：从博物馆、水上乐园，到新加坡的夜间动物园（Night Safari）——Have you ever tried Chinese food outside of China? 把 ever been to / ever tried 用熟，你也能写出这样的旅行推荐。再往前一步就是完成时的延续用法：用 for 和 since 说「拥有、待了多久」，把经历和时间的长度连起来。

methods.name: 经历问答三步走
steps: 第一步问：Have＋主语＋ever＋been to＋地点?
第二步答：去过 Yes, I have. I've been there many times.；没去过 No, I haven't. I've never been there.
第三步补细节：过去时报时间（I went there last year.）
次数放句尾：many times / once / three times
methods.tip: 口诀：ever 问，never 否，答完经历补过去。

methods.name: been gone 分身法
steps: been to＝去过，人已回来：I've been to the art museum many times.
gone to＝去了，人还没回：He has gone to the amusement park.
问「某人此刻在哪」想 gone，聊「有无经历」想 been
句型检查：Have/Has＋主语＋been/gone to＋地点?
methods.tip: 口诀：been 去过回来了，gone 去了还没回。

methods.name: Me too 与 Me neither 应答法
steps: 对方肯定（I've been to the art museum many times.）→ 你也有：Me, too.
对方否定（I've never been to a water park.）→ 你也没有：Me neither.
neither 自带否定，后面不再加 not
顺势邀约：Let's go to one tomorrow.
methods.tip: 口诀：你也有 Me, too，你也没有 Me neither。

examples.question: —Have you ever been to a water park? 从下面三句里选正确的回答：Yes, I have. I went there last summer. / Yes, I did. / No, I wasn't.
examples.solution: 选第一句。经历问答用 have 呼应：Yes, I have.，再补过去时细节 I went there last summer.（去年夏天去的）；did、was 的助动词都对不上。
examples.pitfall: 选 Yes, I did.——问句用的是 Have you ever…，回答要用 Yes, I have.，补细节才用过去时。

examples.question: 补全句子：I have ____ been to the space museum, so I want to go this weekend. 横线上填 never 还是 ever？
examples.solution: 填 never。句子说「从没去过，所以这周末想去」，never 表示「一次也没有」，放在 have 和 been 之间；ever 是疑问句用词，不进陈述句。
examples.pitfall: 填 ever——ever 用来发问（Have you ever…?），陈述里的否定用 never。

examples.question: —Where is Tom? —He has ____ to the amusement park. He'll be back at five. 横线上选 been 还是 gone？
examples.solution: 选 gone。后一句 He'll be back at five（五点才回来）说明人还没回来，「去了没回」用 has gone to；「去过、人已回」才用 been to。
examples.pitfall: 选 been——been to 是「去过且已回来」，人此刻不在、五点才回，要用 gone to。

mistakes: been to 与 gone to 混用：been to 去过已回（I've been there many times.），gone to 去了没回（He has gone to Beijing.）。
never 里再加 not：I've never been there 本身就是否定，别写成 haven't never been。
陈述句里硬塞 ever：ever 属于疑问句 Have you ever…?，说自己的经历用 I've been to… 或 I've never been to…
回应否定用错：对方说没去过，你也没去过要说 Me neither.，不是 Me, too.。

source.unit: Unit 9 Have you ever been to a museum?

exercises.question: —Have you ever been to a science museum? —Yes, I have. I ____ to the National Science Museum last year.
exercises.solution: 经历答完补细节要用一般过去时：last year 是过去时间标志，用 went——原对话正是 I went to the National Science Museum last year.；have gone 表示「去了还没回」，与 last year 冲突。

source.label: 人教新目标八下 P65·科学博物馆对话（Have you ever been to a science museum? Yes, I have. I went to the National Science Museum last year. / No, I haven't. Me neither.）

exercises.question: —I've never been to a water park. —____ Let's go to one this weekend.
exercises.solution: 对方用 never 表否定，你也没去过就说 Me neither.（我也没去过）——语法聚焦原句正是 I've never been to a water park. —Me neither.；Me, too. 只接肯定句。

source.label: 人教新目标八下 P68·语法聚焦经历表达（No, I've never been to a science museum. I've been to the art museum many times. I've never been to a water park. Me neither.）

exercises.question: 补全听力事实：John has never ____ to the space museum, but Linda has ____ to the amusement park.
exercises.solution: 两空都填 been：has never been to 表示「从没去过」，has been to 表示「去过」——听力原句正是 John has never been to the space museum. Linda has been to the amusement park.；这里是聊经历，不是问人此刻在哪，不用 gone。

source.label: 人教新目标八下 P66·听力真假判断（Tina went to the space museum last year. John has never been to the space museum. Linda has been to the amusement park.）变式（been to/never been to 选填）

exercises.question: 采访一位同伴两个经历问题（Have you ever been to…?），再把结果汇报成两句：去过的用 I've been to… 的口径，没去过的用 He/She has never been to…
exercises.answer: 示例：Have you ever been to the Palace Museum? —Yes, I have. Have you ever been to the Bird's Nest? —No, I haven't. 汇报：She has been to the Palace Museum. She has never been to the Bird's Nest.
exercises.solution: 问句用 Have you ever been to…?，答句用 Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.；转述时把 been to 与 never been to 对准对象——这些地标都出自课内的景点清单（the Palace Museum、the Great Wall、the Bird's Nest、the Terracotta Army）。

lessons.summary: 现在完成时谈拥有多久：for 后接一段时长，since 后接时间起点；buy 这类瞬间动词要换成 have had 才能和一段时间连用。
explanation: 这部分的核心句来自语法聚焦的三组问答：How long have you had that bike over there? —I've had it for three years. How long has his son owned the train and railway set? —He's owned it since his fourth birthday. Have you ever played football? —Yes, I did when I was little, but I haven't played for a while now. 庭院拍卖语篇里也有同样的表达：he has owned a train and railway set since his fourth birthday。家乡语篇则把延续感拉得更长：He has lived in Wenzhou for the last 13 years. / I haven't been back for almost three years now. / Children have learned to read and count at my old primary school since the mid-20th century.

have had 不是说曾经有过，而是说从过去某刻一直拥有到现在：一辆骑了三年的自行车、一套从四岁生日玩到现在的火车轨道套装。for 后面放一段时长（for three years、for a while），since 后面放那个起点（since his fourth birthday、since last November、since 2019、since I was 10 years old）。问句固定用 How long have you had/owned/known…? 一开口就是完成时。

操作分三步：第一步，问时长用 How long have you had it? How long has he owned it?；第二步，答句摆结构：主语+have/has+延续动词+for/since+时间；第三步，同一时长可以互推——for three years 就是 since three years ago，since last November 也能换成 for about a year。书上的改写练习是最好的模板：Jim is in Japan. He arrived there three days ago. 改成 Jim has been in Japan for three days.；I have a camera. I bought it in 2009. 改成 I have had the camera since 2009.；I know Anna. I first met her three years ago. 改成 I've known her for three years.

最容易出问题的是瞬间动词：buy、borrow、come、become 这类动作一发生就结束，装不下 for three years 这么长的时间段，必须换成对应的延续动词——buy→have had，borrow→have kept，come→have been in，become→have been。书上的动词填空正考这一转换：We have had a piano since last November. We bought it from the Li family when they moved to the US last year.——买发生在过去（bought），持有延续到现在（have had），两句各司其职。for 与 since 的分工也要盯紧：可以说 for three years，不能说 since three years；要接一段时间就得说 since three years ago。
for/since 是现在完成时的第三块拼图：前面已经学过用 yet/already 谈读书进度、用 ever/never 谈经历，这里补上谈持续时长的一角，完成时就能把进度、经历和时长一起说清。它也是介绍珍爱之物的开头句式：My favorite thing from childhood is… I've had it for/since…。往后更长的叙事写作和完成时深化，都建立在这套问答上。

methods.name: for 加一段，since 加一点
steps: 问时长：How long have you had/owned/known…?
答时长：for+时间段（for three years / for a while / for the last 13 years）
答起点：since+时间点（since 2019 / since his fourth birthday / since last November / since I was 10 years old）
自检：把时间短语读一遍，能数出一段时长用 for，只能指出一个起点用 since
methods.tip: 口诀：for 加一段，since 加一点；一段对一段，一点对一点。

methods.name: 瞬间换延续
steps: buy→have had（买了多久说 have had）
borrow→have kept（借了多久说 have kept）
come→have been in（来某地多久说 have been in）
become→have been（成为某状态多久说 have been）
写完检查：句中若瞬间动词和 for/since 时间段同框，立即换延续动词
methods.tip: 口诀：买来要说 have had，借了就说 have kept；来的瞬间变 been in，变了状态用 been。

examples.question: 选词填空：I've had this bike ____ three years. 横线上该填 for 还是 since？
examples.solution: 填 for。three years 是一段时间，for 后接时间段；题头句 I've had this bike for three years. 正是这个用法。
examples.pitfall: 看到时间就顺手填 since——since 后面要的是时间点，比如 since 2019。

examples.question: 把两句合成一句（用现在完成时加 for 或 since）：I know Anna. I first met her three years ago.
examples.solution: I've known Anna for three years. 书上改写练习的原题：meet 只是遇见的那一下，认识多久要用延续动词 know 的完成式 have known。
examples.pitfall: 写成 I've met Anna for three years——met 是瞬间动作，接不了一段时间。

examples.question: 挑出错误并改正：He has bought the train and railway set since his fourth birthday.
examples.solution: 把 has bought 改成 has owned（或 has had）：He has owned the train and railway set since his fourth birthday. 语篇原句用的正是 has owned…since his fourth birthday。
examples.pitfall: buy 是瞬间动词，since 引出的一直延续到现在的拥有状态，要用 owned/had。

mistakes: 误：I've bought this bike for three years.——buy 是瞬间动词，一段时间要配延续动词：I've had this bike for three years.
误：I've had it since three years.——since 后面接时间点（since 2019 / since three years ago），不能直接接一段时间。
误：How long do you have that bike?——问拥有多久要用现在完成时：How long have you had that bike?
误：She has lived here since five years.——five years 是时间段，用 for five years；要用 since 就说 since five years ago。

source.unit: Unit 10 I've had this bike for three years.

exercises.question: —How long have you had that bike over there? —____
options: I've had it for three years.
I've bought it for three years.
I have it three years ago.
I was having it for three years.
exercises.solution: 语法聚焦原句：How long have you had that bike over there? —I've had it for three years. 问拥有时长，用完成时加 for+时间段作答。

source.label: 人教新目标八下 P76·语法聚焦（How long have you had that bike over there? I've had it for three years.）

exercises.question: 做书上的改写题：I have a camera. I bought it in 2009. 合成一句：I ____ the camera ____ 2009.
exercises.solution: 买发生在 2009 这个起点，拥有延续到现在：have had+since 2009。书上改写示例 Jim has been in Japan for three days. 同理：到达是过去点，待到现在用完成时。

source.label: 人教新目标八下 P76·用 for 或 since 改写句子（I have a camera. I bought it in 2009.）

exercises.question: 下面哪一句完全正确？
options: We have had the piano since last November.
We have bought the piano since last November.
We have had the piano for last November.
We bought the piano since last November and still have it.
exercises.solution: 书上动词填空原句：We have had a piano since last November. We bought it from the Li family when they moved to the US last year. 拥有用 have had+since，买用过去式 bought。

source.label: 人教新目标八下 P76·动词填空（We have had a piano since last November. We bought it from the Li family…）变式（瞬间动词 buy 的正误辨析）

exercises.question: 回家找一件你用了最久的旧物，先用 How long have you had it? 问自己，再用 for 和 since 各写一句回答（一句 for+时间段，一句 since+时间点），注意动词用延续形式。
exercises.answer: 示例：I have a toy bear. I've had it for eight years. = I've had it since 2018.
exercises.solution: 同一个时长有两种说法：for+一段时间，或 since+起点时间点；动词保持 have had 这类延续形式即可。

lessons.summary: 读故事先抓三要素：人物是谁、遇到什么冲突、最后怎样收场；读到悬念问句就停下预测，猜完再往下验证。
explanation: 这一部分从书单聊起：Alice in Wonderland、Little Women、Treasure Island、Oliver Twist、Robinson Crusoe、Tom Sawyer 六本名著，配套问答是 Have you read Little Women yet? —No, I haven't. Have you? —Yes, I've already read it. —What's it like? —It's fantastic. 选书对话里 Steve 谈读后感只用两句：It's about four sisters growing up. It was really good, so I couldn't put it down. 主打语篇改写自 Robinson Crusoe，开头一句定下处境：When I first arrived on this island, I had nothing.

好故事都是一个谜：谁（人物）碰上什么麻烦（冲突），最后怎么样（走向与结局）。鲁滨逊语篇的设计非常典型：一无所有上岛是冲突起点，白手起家是发展，然后 A few weeks ago, I found the marks of another man's feet on the sand.——沙滩上的脚印把悬念推到顶点，紧跟着两个问句 Who else is on my island? How long have they been here? 读到这里停一停，先猜后文再往下验证，这就是续写的萌芽。

抓要素三步走：第一步圈人物，本篇就两位——Robinson Crusoe 和他救下的人：I named him Friday because that was the day I met him.；第二步画冲突句：Although I have lost everything, I have not lost my life. So I will not give up and I will wait for another ship. 还有野人袭击两人那一段；第三步定走向：救下 Friday、I have already taught him some English.、继续等船。人物、冲突、走向齐了，故事就握在手里了。

情节判断最怕张冠李戴：听力判断里 Oliver Twist is about a boy who goes out to sea and finds an island full of treasures. 是错的——出海寻宝岛是 Treasure Island 的情节；Tom Sawyer is about a boy who lives in the United Kingdom. 也是错的，Tom 住在美国。另有两个高频表达要吃透：fantastic（极棒的）用来夸书；couldn't put it down 是爱不释手，别按字面理解成拿不动书。
抓要素加做预测，是读整本书和写读书报告的基本功：报告要写清 what's it about（书里讲什么）、好在哪（It was really good），还得赶在截止日前读完——The book report is due in two weeks. 阅读策略也给出了路径：边读记要点、划主旨，读后用自己的话写一段小结。往后读长篇、写故事续编，都从这一套预测—验证—复述的循环里长出来。

methods.name: 故事三要素抓取法
steps: 一圈人物：故事里是谁（Robinson Crusoe、Friday）
二画冲突：他们遇到什么麻烦（一无所有、沙滩脚印、野人袭击）
三定走向：事情怎么发展收场（救下 Friday、教他英语、等待另一艘船）
methods.tip: 口诀：人物—冲突—走向，三样抓齐故事亮。

methods.name: 悬念预测法
steps: 读到问句或意外处停一停（沙滩脚印、Who else is on my island?）
用已读情节猜后文：既然有人来过，接着会怎样？
读完回头核对：猜对了多少，为什么对、为什么错
methods.tip: 口诀：问号处停一停，猜完再往下读，读完对答案。

examples.question: 鲁滨逊语篇里写道：I named him Friday because that was the day I met him. Friday 这个名字的来历是什么？
examples.solution: 因为鲁滨逊遇到他的那天是星期五，就用相遇的日子给他命名；这是人物要素的关键细节，也是读后问题的原题。
examples.pitfall: 望文生义猜成他生在星期五——原句 because 后面已经把来历说清了。

examples.question: 读到 I found the marks of another man's feet on the sand. 之后，从下面四个推测里选最合理的一个：①他决定立刻离开海岛 ②岛上可能还有别人，他开始警惕观察 ③他把小船拆掉 ④他不再种水果蔬菜。
examples.solution: 选②。脚印说明有人来过，自然引出 Who else is on my island? 的追问和警惕；预测要长在已读情节上。
examples.pitfall: 随手选①——孤岛上并没有现成的船，离开不在合理预测里。

examples.question: 用一句话说出 Robinson Crusoe 语篇的冲突：他遇到了什么麻烦？
examples.solution: 鲁滨逊流落孤岛、失去了一切（Although I have lost everything），后来又发现岛上另有别人、遇到野人袭击，他要在岛上活下去并等待救援。
examples.pitfall: 把冲突说成走向——救下 Friday、教他英语是情节发展，不是麻烦本身。

mistakes: 把 Treasure Island 的寻宝情节安到 Oliver Twist 头上——判断情节句前先想清楚这本书讲谁、讲什么。
只顾查生词，丢了主线——fantastic、cannibals 这类词可以结合上下文猜，人物和冲突不能丢。
把预测当乱猜——预测必须基于已读情节（有脚印说明有人来过），读完还要回头验证。
复述故事漏掉悬念问句——Who else is on my island? 这类问句是预测的抓手，也是最值得讲给别人听的地方。

exercises.question: Why does Robinson Crusoe call the man Friday?
options: Because that was the day he met him.
Because the man was born on Friday.
Because the man likes Friday best.
Because their ship was called Friday.
exercises.solution: 语篇原句：I named him Friday because that was the day I met him. 读后问题原题就问这个名字的来历。

source.label: 人教新目标八下 P59·鲁滨逊语篇与读后问答（I named him Friday because that was the day I met him.）

exercises.question: It's about four sisters growing up. 这句读后感说的是哪本书？
exercises.solution: 选书对话里 Steve 读完 Little Women 后说：It's about four sisters growing up. It was really good, so I couldn't put it down.

source.label: 人教新目标八下 P58·选书对话（Yes, Little Women. I've already finished reading it! It's about four sisters growing up.）

exercises.question: 下面哪一句情节描述是对的？
options: Treasure Island is about a boy who goes out to sea and finds an island full of treasures.
Oliver Twist is about a boy who finds an island full of treasures.
Tom Sawyer is about a boy who lives in the United Kingdom.
Robinson Crusoe lost his life on the island.
exercises.solution: 出海寻宝岛是 Treasure Island 的情节（听力判断里把这句安在 Oliver Twist 头上是错的）；Tom 住在美国不在英国；鲁滨逊虽然在岛上失去一切，但 I have not lost my life。

source.label: 人教新目标八下 P58·听力正误判断（Oliver Twist is about a boy who goes out to sea and finds an island full of treasures. / Tom Sawyer is about a boy who lives in the United Kingdom.）变式（情节与书名配对）

exercises.question: 读完鲁滨逊语篇，往下续写两句：他和 Friday 接下来会遇到什么？写完读一遍，检查人物和已读情节是否接得上。
exercises.answer: 示例：One day, we saw a ship far away. We shouted and waved, and at last the ship came to take us home.
exercises.solution: 续写要接住已有要素：人物（Robinson 和 Friday）、处境（等船）、性格（不放弃），再顺着时间线往下编。

lessons.summary: 60 词志愿者小计划三句式搭骨架：I'll help to… 说想做什么，I could… 说能做什么，because… 说为什么，再加时间地点就成篇。
explanation: 标题句先立样板：I'll help to clean up the city parks. 语法聚焦补足三个句式：I'd like to help homeless people. / You could ask hospitals to let you visit the kids and cheer them up. / I'm making some signs to put up around the school. 志愿者语篇给出成品示范：Mario volunteers at an animal hospital every Saturday morning，理由说得实在——I want to learn more about how to care for animals. I get such a strong feeling of satisfaction when I see the animals get better and the look of joy on their owners' faces. 志愿方向清单也列好了：Working in an old people's home / Helping kids in an after-school program / Being a guide at a museum.

一份志愿计划其实只回答三个问题：我想做什么？我做得来什么？我图什么？想做什么用 will 或 would like to 表态，能做什么用 could 摆本事，图什么用 because 讲理由——帮助别人，自己也收获成长和快乐。敬老院对话里 Tom 的经历就是注脚：reading the newspaper to the old people, or just talking to them，因为 a lot of old people are lonely，We should listen to them and care for them.

成文三步：第一步表态——I'll help to clean up the city parks this weekend. / I'd like to volunteer at an old people's home.；第二步摆能力——I could pick up rubbish and water the flowers. / I could read newspapers to them and chat with them.；第三步讲理由——because I love animals / because the park is our shared home。最后补一句时间就完整了：I'm free to help in / on…。申请信框架里这四问正好对上：想做什么（I'd like to volunteer as…）、擅长什么（I'm good at…）、为什么（because…）、何时有空（I'm free to help in/on…）。

will 与 could 的分工要分清：will 表已经拿定主意的打算（I'll help to…），could 表做得到、语气委婉的提议（We could make some signs. / You could ask hospitals to…）。一篇计划通常 will 定方向、could 列具体做法，通篇都是 will 就少了商量和余地。because 后面要接完整的理由句（because I love animals and want to learn how to care for them），别只丢一个词。另外 volunteer 作动词直接跟地点：volunteer at an animal hospital / in an old people's home。
这套三句式不止写计划：往大扩是申请信（加上称呼 Dear Sir or Madam 和落款），往小缩是一句承诺。表达感受的收尾句也顺手收进词库：a strong feeling of satisfaction / a dream come true / cheer them up——以后写倡议书、活动方案、感谢信，都是同一副骨架。

methods.name: 三句式搭骨架
steps: 第一句表态想做什么：I'll help to… / I'd like to volunteer at…
第二句摆出能做什么：I could…
第三句讲清为什么：because…
补一句时间地点收束：I'm free to help in / on…
methods.tip: 口诀：will 定方向，could 摆本事，because 讲道理。

methods.name: 细节丰满法
steps: 加时间地点：this summer / at the animal hospital
加具体动作：reading the newspaper to the old people / water the flowers
加感受收尾：I get such a strong feeling of satisfaction when…
methods.tip: 口诀：何时何地做什么，一件小事加感受。

examples.question: 把三句排成一段通顺的志愿计划：①This summer I'll help to look after the animals at an animal hospital. ②I could walk the dogs and clean their homes. ③I want to do this because I love animals and want to learn how to care for them.
examples.solution: 顺序是①②③：先表态（will）、再摆能力（could）、后讲理由（because），正是三句式骨架的顺序。
examples.pitfall: 把理由句放开头——理由一般放在具体计划之后作收束。

examples.question: 补全'能做什么'一句：I'll volunteer at the old people's home this summer. I ____ read newspapers to them and chat with them. 横线上填 could 还是 must？
examples.solution: 填 could。could 表示做得到、愿意提供的帮助，语气委婉；语法聚焦示范句 You could ask hospitals to let you visit the kids and cheer them up. 正是这种用法；must 是必须，语气不对。
examples.pitfall: 通篇 will/must 语气过硬——计划里的'能做什么'习惯用 could。

examples.question: 用 because 连成一句：He volunteers at an animal hospital every Saturday morning. + He wants to learn more about how to care for animals.
examples.solution: He volunteers at an animal hospital every Saturday morning because he wants to learn more about how to care for animals. 语篇里 Mario 说的正是这个理由。
examples.pitfall: because 后面只写 because animals 这样的碎片——要接完整的原因句。

mistakes: 通篇只有 will，没有 could——'能做什么'这一环丢了，计划就落不了地。
计划写成空话：I want to help people.——要落到具体活动：help kids learn to read / clean up the city parks / cheer them up。
because 后接不完整——要写完整理由句（because I love animals），不能只写一个词。
volunteer 词性混用——作动词直接接地点（volunteer at an animal hospital），别写成 volunteer to at。

exercises.question: —We need to come up with a plan for the City Park Clean-Up Day. —____
options: We could make some signs and hand them out.
It's hard work, but I love it.
exercises.solution: 清洁日计划的原话就是 We could make some signs. Let's make some notices, too.——用 could 提出能做的事。

source.label: 人教新目标八下 P10·清洁日计划对话（We need to come up with a plan for the City Park Clean-Up Day. We could make some signs.）

exercises.question: 把志愿计划的四件事排成通顺一段：①I'll help to clean up the city parks this weekend. ②I could pick up rubbish and water the flowers. ③I want to do this because the park is our shared home. ④I'm free to help on Saturday morning.
exercises.solution: 表态（①will）→摆能力（②could）→讲理由（③because）→补时间（④free to help on…），四步正好对应申请信框架的四个问题。

source.label: 人教新目标八下 P16·志愿申请信框架（I'd like to volunteer as… I'm good at… because… I'm free to help in / on…）

exercises.question: 给计划补上'为什么'：Mario volunteers at an animal hospital every Saturday morning ____. 横线上选最合适的一项。
options: because he wants to learn more about how to care for animals
because he is too busy with his studies
but he doesn't like animals at all
so he decides to give it up
exercises.solution: 语篇原话：I want to learn more about how to care for animals. 志愿理由通常往'喜欢+想学+帮到谁'上写。

source.label: 人教新目标八下 P11·志愿者语篇（Mario volunteers at an animal hospital every Saturday morning… I want to learn more about how to care for animals.）变式（because 理由句补全）

exercises.question: 用三句式写一份 60 词左右的志愿者计划：第一句 I'll help to…，第二句 I could…，第三句 because…，可再加一句 I'm free to…。写完数一数词数。
exercises.answer: 示例：This summer, I'll help to clean up the city park near my home. I could pick up rubbish, water the flowers and make signs to tell people about it. I want to do this because the park is our shared home and clean places make everyone happy. I'm free to help on Sunday morning.
exercises.solution: 三句式起骨架，加时间地点和具体动作把它撑到 60 词左右：will 定方向、could 摆本事、because 讲道理。

lessons.summary: 用过去进行时报突发事件：先报时间，再说当时正在 was/were doing，when 一引出突发，最后交代结果，四步一篇报道。
explanation: 这部分从一组通话问答练起：What were you doing last night, Linda? I called at seven and you didn't pick up. Linda 的回答给出标准结构——When you called, I was taking a shower.，稍后又有 I was sleeping at that time.，还有两边同时进行的句子 So while you were sleeping, I called Jenny and she helped me. 语法聚焦把问答收拢：What was he doing when the rainstorm came? —He was reading in the library when the rainstorm came. / When it began to rain, Ben was helping his mom make dinner. / While Linda was sleeping, Jenny was helping Mary with her homework.

过去进行时是慢镜头：was/were+动词-ing，画的是过去某刻正在进行、还没结束的画面；when 引出的突发事件是快镜头，咔嚓一下打断慢镜头。风暴语篇就是完整的一出：Ben was helping his mom make dinner when the rain began to beat heavily against the windows.——'正在帮妈妈做晚饭'是慢镜头，'雨开始猛敲窗户'是快镜头。报道一个人经历的突发事件，本质就是把慢镜头、快镜头和结果按顺序摆出来。

报道四步：第一步报时间——At about eight last night / Yesterday morning；第二步放慢镜头——I was doing my homework in my room.；第三步快镜头突发——when the light suddenly went out / when the rainstorm came；第四步交代结果——My dad found a candle and lit it for me. 记者采访的框架正是这么问的：Tell us what happened yesterday morning. So, when the rainstorm suddenly came, what were you doing? 照这个问答填内容，一篇口头报道就成形了。

when 与 while 的分工是本块最大的辨析点：when 后面常接一般过去时的短暂动作（When you called…/ when the rainstorm came），while 后面常接过去进行时的持续画面（While Linda was sleeping… / While I was walking home from school, I saw a strange light in the sky.）；两个持续画面同时进行，就用 while 牵手两个进行时（While Linda was sleeping, Jenny was helping Mary with her homework.）。be 动词别忘了跟主语：I was… / He was… / They were…。自测里那组句子值得背下来：While I was walking home from school, I saw a strange light in the sky. But when I pointed it out to my friend, it went away.
这套四步报道是叙事写作的雏形：风暴语篇的结尾还会升华一句——Although the storm broke many things apart, it brought families and neighbors closer together. 往后写记叙文、讲难忘的经历，都是时间—当时—事件—结果的骨架，再添一句感受收尾。听别人报道时也一样，抓住这四步，就能复述个八九不离十。

methods.name: 报道四步法
steps: 第一步报时间：At about eight last night / Yesterday morning
第二步放慢镜头：I was doing…（was/were+动词-ing）
第三步快镜头突发：when+一般过去时（when the light went out）
第四步交代结果：So… / Finally…
methods.tip: 口诀：时间—正在—突发—结果，四步成篇不缺角。

methods.name: when/while 分工法
steps: 短暂插入用 when：when you called / when the rainstorm came
持续背景用 while：While I was walking home…
两个进行时同时进行，用 while 牵线两边
检查 be 动词：I was / He was / They were
methods.tip: 口诀：when 一下，while 一段；两段同时，while 牵线。

examples.question: 选词填空：____ Linda was sleeping, Jenny was helping Mary with her homework. 横线上填 when 还是 while？
examples.solution: 填 while。两边都是过去进行时的持续画面，用 while 牵线；语法聚焦原句就是 While Linda was sleeping, Jenny was helping Mary with her homework.
examples.pitfall: 看见'当……时'就填 when——两个同时进行的持续动作用 while。

examples.question: 填空并检查 be 动词：They ____ (have) dinner in the kitchen when they heard the news on the radio.
examples.solution: were having。主语 they 配 were，have 变 having；'正在吃晚饭'是慢镜头，'听到新闻'是 when 引出的快镜头。
examples.pitfall: 只顾变 -ing 忘了 be 动词——They was 是错的，复数用 were。

examples.question: 把四句排成一篇通顺的小报道：①At about eight last night, I was doing my homework at home. ②When I was writing, the light suddenly went out. ③My dad found a candle and lit it for me. ④Then I went on with my homework by candlelight.
examples.solution: ①②③④：先报时间与慢镜头，再 when 引出突发，接着写应对，最后收在结果。
examples.pitfall: 把结果句放在突发前——报道要按时间线走，先出事再应对。

mistakes: 误：When the rainstorm came, I read in the library.——想表达'当时正读到一半'要用过去进行时：I was reading in the library when the rainstorm came.
误：While I was taking a shower, the phone was ringing.——电话响是一下子的事，用一般过去时：…the phone rang.
误：They was playing basketball.——复数主语配 were。
报道漏了结果——只说当时在做什么，不说后来怎样，听众听完还是不知道事情怎么了。

exercises.question: —What was he doing when the rainstorm came? —____
options: He was reading in the library.
exercises.solution: 语法聚焦原句：He was reading in the library when the rainstorm came. 问当时正在做什么，用过去进行时回答。

source.label: 人教新目标八下 P36·语法聚焦（What was he doing when the rainstorm came? He was reading in the library when the rainstorm came.）

exercises.question: 补全记者采访：—So, when the rainstorm suddenly came, what were you doing? —I ____ (wait) for the bus.
exercises.solution: 问句已经给出 were doing 的框架，答句保持一致：I was waiting for the bus.——雨中在等公交车正是这一板块的场景之一。

source.label: 人教新目标八下 P34·记者采访（TV reporter: So, when the rainstorm suddenly came, what were you doing?）

exercises.question: 自测句变式，选词填空：____ I was walking home from school, I saw a strange light in the sky. 横线上填 While 还是 When？
exercises.solution: walking home 是持续背景动作，用 while 引出；下一句 But when I pointed it out to my friend, it went away. 里的一下子动作才用 when。

source.label: 人教新目标八下 P40·自测 when/while 填空（While I was walking home from school, I saw a strange light in the sky.）变式（when/while 选词）

exercises.question: 想一件你经历过的小突发事件（停电、阵雨、找不到东西都行），按四步说给家人听：报时间→当时正在做什么→when 突发→结果，说完让对方复述一遍，检查四步齐不齐。
exercises.answer: 示例：At about nine last night, I was reading in bed. When I was reading, the light suddenly went out. My mom found a flashlight, and we looked at the old photos together by its light.
exercises.solution: 四步各一句就够：时间、was/were doing、when+一般过去时、结果；平时多练口头报道，写记叙文时直接搬骨架。

lessons.summary: 全册词汇约 720 词分层自查：黑体重点词要过听说读写四关；过去分词集中建库，三态同形一族与 gone/been 的区别是两道关卡。
explanation: 册末的词汇工具分几块：先按内容顺序列出各部分的词与短语，注明重点词汇用黑体标出、英式美式发音有区别时分别注音；再按字母顺序把全册词汇建成总索引，累计约 720 个词与短语；最后是不规则动词表，三栏对齐：原形—过去式—过去分词，例如 put-put-put、cut-cut-cut、read（原形读 /riːd/）-read /red/-read /red/，以及 go-went-gone、be（am/is/are）-was/were-been、buy-bought-bought、write-wrote-written。
词汇要分层管理：黑体词是重点词，要求听、说、读、写四会——听到能懂、开口能说、看到能认、提笔能写；非黑体词做到听得懂、读得出即可。死记词表容易背了就忘，书里的词都长在句子上：have had this bike、come up with a plan、take a shower、pick up rubbish——记词顺手记搭配，一词带走一条短语。

自查三件套：第一关按内容板块滚动默写，把黑体词中英互默，错的收进错词本；第二关分词变形，把不规则动词按三态归类默写——三态同形一族 cut、put、let、set、shut、hurt、cost、read（read 的过去式和过去分词拼写不变、读音变 /red/），ABB 型 buy-bought-bought、have-had-had，ABC 型 go-went-gone、write-wrote-written、be-was/were-been；第三关语篇填空，把动词放回完成时句子里填分词，比如 She has already read more than 100 different books! 和 I have already cut down trees and built a house.

两道高频关卡：一是三态同形词千万别加 -ed——不说 cutted、putted；read 在完成时里要改读 /red/：Have you read Treasure Island yet? 二是 gone 与 been 之分：have gone to 是去了（人在那边还没回来），have been to 是去过（去了已经回来）——He has gone to Beijing. 说明他现在不在；He has been to Beijing. 说明他去过后回来了。判断只看人在不在：人不在用 gone，回过用 been。
词汇自查是长线功夫：黑体词滚动默写防遗忘，分词库随学随补——往后完成时深化、被动语态都要用过去分词，这张表会一路用下去。养成分词变形随口报三态的习惯（go—went—gone），再加上语篇填空验手感，词汇和语法就串成了一张网。

methods.name: 分词三态归类法
steps: AAA 同形：cut put let set shut hurt cost，read（过去式与过去分词读音 /red/）
ABB 型：buy-bought-bought，have-had-had，make-made-made
ABC 型：go-went-gone，write-wrote-written，be-was/were-been
随口报三态自测：说原形，连报过去式和过去分词
methods.tip: 口诀：同形一族念三遍——cut put let set shut hurt read（红）；去了用 gone，回过用 been。

methods.name: gone/been 判别法
steps: 先问人在不在说话的地方
人不在（还没回来）：has gone to
人回过（去过已回）：has been to
造句自检：He has gone to the library. He'll be back soon. / He has been to the library twice.
methods.tip: 口诀：去了用 gone，回过用 been；先看人，再选词。

methods.name: 四会自查三件套
steps: 第一关按内容板块滚动默写黑体词，错词进本
第二关不规则动词三态归类默写
第三关完成时语篇填空验实际会用
methods.tip: 口诀：默写—变形—填空，三关都过才算会。

examples.question: 下列哪个动词的三态（原形—过去式—过去分词）拼写完全相同？read / write / go / see
examples.solution: read。它是三态同形词，只是过去式和过去分词读音变成 /red/；write 是 write-wrote-written，go 是 go-went-gone，see 是 see-saw-seen。
examples.pitfall: 以为 read 三态读音也一样——拼写相同，读音要变 /red/。

examples.question: —Where is Tom? —He ____ to the library. He'll be back in an hour. 横线上填 has gone 还是 has been？
examples.solution: 填 has gone。人现在不在、还没回来，用 has gone to；如果说他去过、已经回来了，才用 has been to。
examples.pitfall: 只看词形不看人在不在——判断标准始终是：去了 gone，回过 been。

examples.question: 用过去分词补全完成时句子：Sally has already ____ (read) more than 100 different books!
examples.solution: 填 read（读 /red/）。填空语篇的原句就是 She has already read more than 100 different books!——完成时里 read 的过去分词拼写不变、读音变。
examples.pitfall: 读成 /riːd/——完成时里要读 /red/，口头自查时最容易漏。

mistakes: 误说 cutted、putted——三态同形动词不加 -ed，cut put let set shut hurt cost 全族照原形写。
误把 Have you read…yet? 的 read 读成 /riːd/——完成时里的 read 读 /red/。
误：He has been to Beijing, so he isn't here now.——been 是去过已回，人不在要用 has gone to。
黑体重点词只认不写——四会词必须会默写，只看得见拼不出的词，写的时候就卡壳。

exercises.question: 下面哪一组动词的三态（原形—过去式—过去分词）拼写完全相同？
exercises.solution: 册末不规则动词表里 cut、put、let、set、shut、hurt、cost、read 都是三态同形；go、write、see 都是三态各异。

source.label: 人教新目标八下 P136·不规则动词表（cut cut cut / put put put / read /riːd/—/red/—/red/）

exercises.question: —Have you read Treasure Island yet? —Yes, I have. I've already ____ it.
exercises.solution: 问答原句：Have you read Little Women yet? —Yes, I've already read it. read 的过去分词仍是 read，读音 /red/。

source.label: 人教新目标八下 P57·名著问答（Have you read Little Women yet? Yes, I've already read it.）

exercises.question: 选词填空变式：My parents have ____ to the museum twice, so they know it well.
exercises.solution: 去过两次（twice）说明人回来了，用 have been to；have gone to 表示人还在那边没回来，不能和 twice 连用。

source.label: 人教新目标八下 P136·不规则动词表（go went gone / be was, were been）变式（gone 与 been 辨析填空）

exercises.question: 给自己设计一张全册词汇自查表：列出黑体词默写进度（按内容板块分成十份）、不规则动词过去分词归类栏（同形/ABB/ABC 三栏）、两句待填的完成时句子，并写下自查顺序。
exercises.answer: 示例顺序：先默第 1 份黑体词并订正→归类默写 10 个不规则动词的三态→完成两句填空（如 She has already ____ (cut) down the old tree. / They have ____ (go) to Shanghai.）→错词收本，三天后重默。
exercises.solution: 自查的关键是滚动和验证：默写管拼写，归类管变形，语篇填空管实际使用；错词单独收本、定期回默。

lessons.summary: 用 by + V-ing 说清学习妙招：想做某事有方法，by 后动词穿 -ing，一问 How 一答 by，句句能落地。
explanation: 书上的这部分围绕一个核心问题展开：How do you study for a test?（你怎样备考？），答句统一用 by + V-ing 结构：I study by working with a group.（我通过小组合作学习）、I study by making word cards.（我做单词卡）。随后列出一串学习方式：by working with friends（和朋友一起学）、by reading aloud（大声朗读）、by listening to tapes（听录音）、by asking the teacher for help（向老师求助）。语法聚焦里继续巩固：How do you learn English? — I learn by studying with a group. / Do you learn English by reading aloud? — Yes, I do. It helps my pronunciation.（它能帮我练发音）。

by 在这里表示“通过什么手段、用什么办法”，专门回答 How（怎么做）开头的问句。可以类比坐车出行：by bus（坐公交）、by bike（骑自行车）说的是“乘什么工具”；by + V-ing 说的是“做什么动作”。动词加上 -ing 之后就像变成了一个“事情”：reading aloud 就是“大声朗读这件事”。所以“我通过大声朗读来学习”就是 I study by reading aloud.——by 像一座小桥，桥这边是主语，桥那边是方法。

造句三步：第一步想清楚目标和办法；第二步在办法前加介词 by；第三步把动词改成 -ing 形式（write→writing 要先去 e，begin→beginning 要双写 n）。回答 How 问句时，直接用 By + V-ing. 也可以，比如 How do you learn new words? — By making word cards. 书上还给出万能建议句：You could try to improve your English by ...（你可以试着通过……来提高英语），书面表达里很好用。
三个最常混的地方：一是 by 后误接动词原形或不定式，“通过大声朗读”要写 by reading aloud，不是 by read aloud，也不是 by to read；二是 by 和 with 分工不同：by 接动作方式，with 接工具名词；三是提问方式要用 How 而不是 What——What 问“什么”，How 问“怎么做”。另外 by 短语单独作答句时，句首 By 要大写。

by + V-ing 会一路陪你走完初中英语：说明学习建议要用它——You can read faster by reading word groups.（通过按意群阅读读得更快）；猜词也要靠它——guess a word's meaning by reading the sentences before and after it（通过读前后句猜词义）；后面的被动语态里还会遇到另一个 by（by + 动作执行者），到时注意分辨：一个表“方式”，一个表“由谁做”。平时整理错题时，也可以顺手给每道题配一条 by + V-ing 的改进办法，把语法变成行动。

methods.name: 三步搭出 by + V-ing
steps: 第一步：想清楚要通过做什么来达成目标（背单词、练听力、纠发音……）；
第二步：在这个动作前面加介词 by；
第三步：把动词改成 -ing 形式，注意 write→writing 去 e、begin→beginning 双写 n。
methods.tip: 方式手段要用 by，by 后动词加 ing。

methods.name: How 问句配对接龙
steps: 用 How do you study/learn...? 向同伴提问；
用 I study/learn by + V-ing. 回答，动词原形立刻变 -ing；
轮换 by 后面的短语（working with friends / reading aloud / making word cards / asking the teacher for help），连成一条问答链。
methods.tip: 一问 How 一答 by，动词记得换 ing。

methods.name: by 与 with 分工表
steps: by + 动作（V-ing）表做法：by listening to tapes 通过听录音；
with + 工具名词表用具：write with a pen 用钢笔写；
拿不准时自问：我说的是“做法”还是“用具”？做法用 by，用具用 with。
methods.tip: by 管做法，with 管家伙。

examples.question: 选词填空：You can read faster _____ reading word groups.（by / with / to）
examples.solution: 选 by。句子说“通过按意群阅读来读得更快”，表示方式用 by，后接 -ing：You can read faster by reading word groups.
examples.pitfall: 看到 by 就要想到后面的动词要变成 -ing。

examples.question: 用所给动词的正确形式填空：I learned a lot by _____ (watch) English movies.
examples.solution: 填 watching。介词 by 后面接动名词，watch 变 watching。
examples.pitfall: 不能填原形 watch，也不能填 to watch。

examples.question: 选出能回答“—How do you learn new words?”的一项：① By making word cards. ② Yes, I do. ③ To make word cards. ④ By a word card.
examples.solution: 选 ①。How 问句问方式，用 By + V-ing 短语回答；②答非所问，③用了不定式，④by 后接了名词而不是动作。
examples.pitfall: 答句开头的 By 在句首要大写。

mistakes: 把“通过大声朗读”写成 by read aloud——介词 by 后必须接 V-ing，正确说法是 by reading aloud。
混淆 by 与 with 的分工：说做法用 by + V-ing，说用具用 with + 名词，不能把“用钢笔写”说成 by a pen。
提问方式误用 What：问方法要说 How do you study...?，What 问的是“什么”而不是“怎么做”。
V-ing 拼写出错：write 要去 e 变 writing，begin 要双写 n 变 beginning，listen 直接加 ing 变 listening。

source.unit: Unit 1 How can we become good learners?

exercises.question: 单选：—How do you practice speaking? —_____
exercises.solution: How 提问方式，答句用 By + V-ing 短语；书上的对应回答正是 By having conversations with friends.（通过与朋友对话来练口语）。

source.label: 人教新目标九全 P4·语法聚焦问答回（How do you practice speaking? By having conversations with friends.）

exercises.question: 改错：She improves her writing by write e-mails to her pen pals.（找出错误并写出正确的句子）
exercises.answer: 把 write 改为 writing：She improves her writing by writing e-mails to her pen pals.
exercises.solution: 介词 by 后接动名词，write 需变为 writing（去 e 加 -ing）。书上有 By writing e-mails to my pen pals. 的说法。

source.label: 人教新目标九全 P4·语法聚焦句式（By writing e-mails to my pen pals.）

exercises.question: 变式单选：—_____ do you memorize new words? —_____ making word cards.
exercises.solution: 问方式用 How；表示“通过做某事”用 By + V-ing。完整对话：How do you memorize new words? — By making word cards.

source.label: 人教新目标九全 P1·学习方式问答变式（How do you study for a test? I study by working with a group.）

exercises.question: 给你的朋友写一条英语学习建议，用上句式 “You can improve your English by ...”，再补一句说明这样做的理由。
exercises.answer: 示例：You can improve your pronunciation by reading aloud every morning, because it helps a lot with your spoken English.
exercises.solution: 句中 by 后接 V-ing（reading aloud）；理由句说清这样做的好处即可，注意把方法写具体、可执行。

lessons.summary: 把整句话装进 think、wonder 后面：陈述句用 that，问“是否”用 if/whether，从句永远按主语加谓语排好队。
explanation: 这一部分从节日话题引出宾语从句：I think that mooncakes are delicious!（我觉得月饼很好吃）、I love the races. I think that they're fun to watch.（我觉得比赛看起来很有趣）。接着出现“想知道”类：I wonder if they'll have the races again next year.（我想知道明年是否还会再办比赛）、I wonder whether June is a good time to visit Hong Kong.。语法聚焦把这些句子集中成对呈现：I know that the Water Festival is really fun. / I believe that April is the hottest month in Thailand.，从句内部全部是“主语 + 谓语”的陈述语序。
宾语从句就是“把一整句话装进另一个句子里当宾语”，像把写好的纸条装进信封：I think 是信封，后面整句是信纸。think / believe / know 后面装的是你的“看法和消息”，用 that 连接（口语里常常省掉）；wonder 后面装的是“想知道的事”，如果原来是“……吗？”这样的一般疑问句，就用 if 或 whether，意思是“是否”。

造宾语从句三步：第一步看主句动词（think / believe / know / wonder / hope 这类能“装句子”的动词）；第二步选引导词——原句是陈述句用 that，原句是一般疑问句用 if 或 whether；第三步把从句排成陈述语序：主语在前、谓语在后。比如 Bill wonders whether they'll have zongzi again next year.（Bill 想知道明年是否会再吃粽子）。

四个易混点：一是 that 可省略，if / whether 一般不省，也不能换成 that；二是从句语序最容易被问句带偏——I wonder if they'll have the races again next year. 里 they 照常排在 will 前面，不能写成 if will they have；三是 that 和 what 不同：what 要在从句里充当主语或宾语，that 只起连接作用、不充当成分；四是主句动词的“口气”：think / believe 表看法，wonder 带着好奇和委婉，选动词先想清自己的态度。
宾语从句共有三个要点，本节掌握了引导词和陈述语序两个；第三个要点“时态呼应”会在后续总复习里补齐。表达观点的 I think that... / I believe that... 是书面表达的高频句式，发表看法、说明理由都离不开它；下一节还会把从句装进 Could you please tell me...? 这样的礼貌外壳里，向别人礼貌地打听消息。

methods.name: 引导词三分法
steps: 原句是陈述句（某事如何如何）→ 用 that，口语里可省略；
原句是一般疑问句（……吗？）→ 用 if 或 whether，意为“是否”；
从句一律排成“主语 + 谓语”的陈述语序再装进去。
methods.tip: 陈述 that 可省略，是否 if/whether 接；从句永远陈述序。

methods.name: 信封装句法
steps: 先把要装进去的句子写完整、写通顺；
前面套上 I think / I believe / I wonder 等信封；
检查从句主语谓语没有被倒装，问句里的 will / does 等已回到主语后面。
methods.tip: 主句当信封，从句是信纸；纸要平铺，不能折角（倒装）。

examples.question: 合并句子：I think + The mooncakes are delicious.（合并为含宾语从句的一句话）
examples.solution: I think (that) the mooncakes are delicious. that 可保留也可省略，从句保持陈述语序。
examples.pitfall: 省略 that 后句子依然成立，但初学阶段建议先写上 that 再慢慢体会。

examples.question: 选词填空：I wonder _____ they'll have the races again next year.（if / what / who）
examples.solution: 填 if。原句“明年还会再办比赛吗？”是一般疑问句，问“是否”用 if（也可用 whether）：I wonder if they'll have the races again next year.
examples.pitfall: 不能选 what 或 who——它们要在从句里充当成分，而这里从句成分已经完整。

examples.question: 原意是“不知道他是否会来过节”，哪一句正确？① I don't know if he will come to the festival. ② I don't know if will he come to the festival. ③ I don't know that he will come to the festival.
examples.solution: 选 ①。“是否”要用 if，且从句 he will come 保持陈述语序；②把 will 提前变成疑问语序，③用 that 把“是否”说成了“那件事”。
examples.pitfall: 检查语序：从句里主语 he 要排在 will 前面。

mistakes: 从句被问句带偏用成疑问语序：I wonder if will they have the races again next year. 是错的，应把 will 放回主语后面：if they'll have...
一般疑问句变宾语从句时误用 that：I wonder that... 不对，问“是否”要用 if 或 whether。
该用 what 的地方误用 that：I don't know that he said. 不对——what 在从句里要作 said 的宾语，that 不能充当成分。
把 if / whether 随意省略：that 可以省，但 if / whether 担着“是否”的意思，一般不能省。

source.unit: Unit 2 I think that mooncakes are delicious!

exercises.solution: 书上的原句是 I believe that April is the hottest month in Thailand.（泰国四月是最热的月份），the 后接形容词最高级 hottest。

Do you know if the museum is open on Monday?
Do you know that is the museum open on Monday?
Do you know the museum is open if on Monday?
exercises.solution: 问“是否”用 if，从句 the museum is open 保持陈述语序；A、C 把 is 提前造成倒装，D 把 if 放错了位置。

exercises.question: 以“我最喜欢的节日”为话题，用 I think that... 和 I wonder if... 各写一句话，写完自查两点：引导词选得对不对，从句是不是陈述语序。
exercises.answer: 示例：I think that the Dragon Boat Festival is exciting. I wonder if we will watch the races this year.
exercises.solution: 观点句用 that，问“是否”用 if；写完逐句检查从句主语是否排在谓语前面。

lessons.summary: 礼貌打听消息有公式：Could you please tell me 后接疑问词加陈述语序，从句主谓不倒装，问路求助不尴尬。
explanation: 这一部分教“礼貌地问信息”：Could you please tell me where the restrooms are?（请问洗手间在哪里？）——注意从句是 where the restrooms are，不是 where are the restrooms。书里反复出现同一类外壳：Excuse me, could you please tell me how to get to the bookstore?（请问去书店怎么走？）/ Do you know when the bookstore closes today?（你知道书店今天几点关门吗？）/ Excuse me, do you know where I can buy some medicine? — Sure. There's a supermarket down the street.（街上有一家超市）。还有委婉的 I wonder where we should go next.（我想知道接下来该去哪）。
直接问 Where are the restrooms? 语法没错，但听起来像查户口；套上 Could you please tell me... 就像先敲了敲门，语气立刻客气起来。礼貌外壳里装的不是问句原样，而是“改装版”：疑问词仍然打头，但后面的主语谓语要按陈述句的顺序平铺——像把一叠纸放进信封前先抚平整。

把直接问句改装成礼貌问句三步：第一步写出直接问句，如 Where can I buy some grapes?；第二步选外壳：Could you please tell me...? / Do you know...? / I wonder... / Pardon me, could you tell me...?；第三步把问句装进去并改成陈述语序——Could you please tell me where I can buy some grapes? 陌生场合别忘了句首加 Excuse me。

几个高频混淆：一是语序——从句里助动词、be 动词必须回到主语后面：when the band starts playing 是对的（when does the band start 就错了）；二是 how to get to 和 how I can get to 两种说法都对，简式用“疑问词 + to do”，从句式别忘了主语；三是 get to 后面接地点名词（get to the post office），但 get home / get here 这类地点副词前不加 to。
问路指路是听力与情景交际的高频考点，礼貌求助句式也是书面表达里咨询信的开场模板。宾语从句的要点至此已经凑齐大半——that、if/whether、特殊疑问词三类引导词和陈述语序都已上手，时态呼应留待总复习串线；再往后学到被动语态、情态动词时，这套“外壳 + 从句”的句式还会反复登场。

methods.name: 礼貌三件套
steps: 开场加 Excuse me / Pardon me 引起注意；
套外壳：Could you please tell me...? / Do you know...? / I wonder...；
从句用“疑问词 + 主语 + 谓语”的陈述语序收尾。
methods.tip: Excuse me 起个头，could you please 语气温；从句平铺陈述序。

methods.name: 直接句改装三步
steps: 先写直接问句：Where is the bank?；
把 is / can / does 等送回主语后面：where the bank is；
套壳成句：Could you please tell me where the bank is?
methods.tip: 疑问词领路，主谓随后行，助动词回原位。

examples.question: 单选：Could you please tell me _____? ① where the restrooms are ② where are the restrooms ③ where the restrooms is ④ where is the restrooms
examples.solution: 选 ①。从句用陈述语序：the restrooms 排在 are 前面；restrooms 是复数，配 are。
examples.pitfall: 最典型的错误就是把从句写成 where are the restrooms。

examples.question: 把直接问句改得更礼貌：How do I get to the Central Library?
examples.solution: Could you please tell me how to get to the Central Library? 或 Could you please tell me how I can get to the Central Library?
examples.pitfall: 两种改法都对：how to get to（简式）与 how I can get to（从句式）；注意 get to 后面要带 the。

examples.question: 补全对话：—Excuse me, do you know _____ I can buy some medicine? —Sure. There's a supermarket down the street.（where / what / when / who）
examples.solution: 填 where。答句回答了地点，问句自然问“在哪里能买到药”。
examples.pitfall: 先看答句再定疑问词：答地点选 where，答时间选 when。

mistakes: 从句保留疑问语序：Do you know where is the bookstore? 是错的，应为 where the bookstore is。
只套外壳不改装，从句丢了主语或把助动词提前，说出来像半截话。
how to get 后面漏掉 to：去某地要说 how to get to the post office；但 get home / get here 前不加 to。
对陌生人开口不加 Excuse me / Pardon me，句子再对也显得生硬不礼貌。

source.unit: Unit 3 Could you please tell me where the restrooms are?

exercises.question: 单选：—Could you please tell me where I can buy a magazine? —_____
options: There's a bookstore on the third floor.
exercises.solution: 问句问“在哪里能买到杂志”，答句指明地点：There's a bookstore on the third floor.（三楼有一家书店）。

source.label: 人教新目标九全 P24·自测问答（Could you please tell me where I can buy a magazine? — There's a bookstore on the third floor.）

exercises.question: 按“把句子改得更有礼貌”的要求改写：Where can I buy some grapes or other fruit?
exercises.answer: Could you please tell me where I can buy some grapes or other fruit?
exercises.solution: 套上外壳 Could you please tell me，从句 where I can buy... 保持陈述语序。
